1.title: Liyini Isheya?
1.content: Cabanga ukuthi wena nabangani abangu-9 nifaka ngamunye u-{c}10 ukuze nithenge izicathulo ze-{c}100 ndawonye. Ngamunye wenu unengxenye engu-1/10 yalezo zicathulo, futhi leyo yiyo kanye into ebizwa ngesheya! Uma uthenga isheya ku-{retail}, unengxenyana yaso sonke isitolo, yawo wonke umkhiqizo, nalo lonke i{cName} abalenzayo. Uma inkampani ikhula, nengxenye yakho iba nenani elikhulu! 🔥

quiz.q: Wena nabangani abangu-4 nihlukaniselana ngokulinganayo izindleko zesihlalo sokudlala se-{c}500. Ngamunye wenu uba nani?
quiz.explanation: Ukuba nesheya kusho ukuba nengxenye yento yonke. Abantu abahlanu abakhokha ngokulinganayo basho izingxenye ezinhlanu ezilinganayo, futhi ingxenye ngayinye inamalungelo afanayo nezinye.
options: Ingxenye engu-1/5 (20%) yesihlalo ngamunye
Lutho, umuntu oyedwa kuphela ongaba naso
Isihlalo sonke ndawonye, kungabikho ngxenye yomuntu ngamunye

2.title: I-{ex} Ichaziwe
2.content: Cabanga i-{ex} ({exFull}) njengemakethe enkulu ye-inthanethi, kodwa esikhundleni sokuthenga izicathulo noma amaselula, abantu bathenga futhi bathengise izingxenyana (amasheya) zezinkampani ezinjenge-{top5}. Ivulekile zonke izinsuku zomsebenzi ngaphandle kwamaholide omphakathi, futhi amanani ashintsha usuku lonke ngokuya kothengayo nothengisayo. I-{ex} {exDesc}! 🌍

quiz.q: I-{ex} ifana kakhulu nani?
quiz.explanation: Imakethe yamasheya ihlanganisa abantu abafuna ukuthenga amasheya nabantu abafuna ukuwathengisa. Ayinawo amasheya, ayikhethi inani, futhi ngeke ikukhokhele inzalo ngokushiya imali kuyo.
options: Imakethe, lapho abanamasheya behlangana nabathengi
I-akhawunti yokonga, lapho imali ihlala khona izuze inzalo
Isitolo esinamasheya bese sikuthengisela wona

3.title: Izinkunzi Namabhere
3.content:
Ezimakethe, izilwane yizo eziphethe 😄

🐂 Inkunzi = amanani AYENYUKA. Cabanga inkunzi ehlasela iphakamisela izimpondo phezulu. Wonke umuntu uyawina, abantu bayathenga, izinto zimnandi.

🐻 Ibhere = amanani AYEHLA. Cabanga ibhere elishaya phansi ngonyawo lwalo. Abantu bayesaba, bayathengisa, akusona isikhathi esihle.

Uma umuntu ethi 'ngi-bullish nge-{tech}', usho ukuthi ucabanga ukuthi inani lizokhuphuka. Uma ethi 'ngi-bearish', ucabanga ukuthi lizokwehla. Uzowezwa la magama yonke indawo kwezezimali!

quiz.q: Umngani wakho uthi 'ngi-bearish nge-{telco} kuleli sonto.' Kusho ukuthini lokho?
quiz.explanation: I-bearish isho ukulindela ukuthi inani lizokwehla, i-bullish isho ukulindela ukuthi lizokhuphuka. Ibhere lishaya liye phansi, inkunzi iphonsa iye phezulu.
options: Ucabanga ukuthi inani le-{telco} lizokhuphuka
Ucabanga ukuthi inani le-{telco} lizokwehla
Ufuna ukuthenga i-{telco} eningi ngangokunokwenzeka

4.title: Iyini I-broker?
4.content:
Awukwazi nje ukungena ku-{retail} uthi 'ngicela unginike ingxenye yenkampani yakho' 😂 Udinga i-broker: i-app noma insizakalo exhumanisa abathengi nabathengisi emakethe yamasheya.

Cabanga i-broker njenge-{shop}. Ufuna into, i-{shop} ikuxhumanisa nayo. Iphatha ukuthengiselana bese ikhokhisa imali encane. Ama-broker adumile e{name} afaka phakathi i-{broker} nabanye.

Nakhu i-broker ENGAKWENZI: ayinqumi ukuthi yimaphi amasheya azokhuphuka. Idlulisela i-oda lakho emakethe. Inani lishintsha ngenxa yalokho wonke umuntu akuthengayo nakuthengisayo, hhayi ngoba i-broker yakho ishilo.

Nokho ama-broker ayayikhipha imibono. Abahlaziyi bawo banikeza amasheya isilinganiso sokuthi 'thenga', 'bambelela' noma 'thengisa'. Umbono awuwona umyalo 🤷 Abahlaziyi bayaphikisana obala ngesheya elilodwa vo, futhi abaningi babo bagcina bephambene. Funda isilinganiso njengombono, hhayi njengomthetho.

I-NoobTrader ikufundisa kahle kahle ukuthi lokhu kusebenza kanjani, mahhala, ngemali yokuzijwayeza!

quiz.q: Kungani udinga i-broker ukuze uthenge amasheya?
quiz.explanation: I-broker iyindlela yakho yokungena emakethe yamasheya, ayiyona isangoma futhi ayibeki inani. Idlulisela i-oda, bese inani liba yilokho okunye kwemakethe okuzimisele ukuhweba ngakho. Abahlaziyi bayo bakhipha izilinganiso, kodwa isilinganiso singumbono, hhayi umyalo.
options: Ikhetha amasheya azokhuphuka
Ibeka inani olikhokhayo esheyeni ngalinye
Idlulisela i-oda lakho emakethe yamasheya

5.title: Izisekelo Zenani Lesheya
5.content:
Uke wabona ukuthi izicathulo ezikhishwe ngobuningi obulinganiselwe zinyuka kanjani ngenani uma zikhishwa? Kwenzeka okufanayo ngamasheya. Konke kumayelana nokutholakala nesidingo.

📈 Abantu abaningi BAFUNA ukuthenga → inani LIYENYUKA
📉 Abantu abaningi BAFUNA ukuthengisa → inani LIYEHLA

Uma i-{telco} imemezela ukuthi ithola amakhasimende amasha ayizigidi eziyi-10, wonke umuntu ufuna ingxenye, ngakho inani liyaqhuma. Uma ibika ukulahlekelwa okukhulu, abantu bathengisa ngokwethuka, bese inani liyawa. Izindaba, imiphumela, ngisho nezitayela zezokuxhumana zingawashintsha amanani amasheya ngaso leso sikhathi!

quiz.q: I-{retail} imemezela inzuzo eyirekhodi nezinhlelo zokuvula izitolo ezingu-50 ezintsha. Kungenzeka kwenzekeni enanini lesheya layo?
quiz.explanation: Inzuzo engcono elindelekile ivame ukusho abathengi abaningi, futhi abathengi abaningi baphusha inani liye phezulu. Ukusebenzisa imali ukuze ukhule akufani nokuyichitha.
options: Liyakhuphuka njengoba abantu abaningi befuna ukuthenga
Lihlala lifana ncamashi
Liyawohloka ngoba ichitha imali ezitolo

6.title: Ukufunda Igrafu Lamanani
6.content:
Igrafu lamanani lifana nevidiyo yezingqophamlando zomlando wesheya. Uhlobo oludume kakhulu igrafu lamakhandlela. Ikhandlela ngalinye likutshela izinto ezi-4 zosuku olulodwa:

🟢 Ikhandlela eliluhlaza = inani LIKHUPHUKILE ngalolo suku (livule liphansi, lavala liphezulu)
🔴 Ikhandlela elibomvu = inani LEHLILE (livule liphezulu, lavala liphansi)
📏 Imigqa emincane engenhla nengezansi = amanani aphezulu kakhulu naphansi kakhulu osuku

Uma ubona amakhandlela amaningi aluhlaza elandelana, lowo umkhuba oqinile wokwenyuka. Uma amaningi ebomvu, lowo umkhuba wokwehla. Ukufunda ukufunda amagrafu kufana nokufunda ibhodi lamaphuzu emdlalweni! 🎮

quiz.q: Ubona amakhandlela abomvu ayi-5 elandelana egrafini. Lokhu kukutshelani?
quiz.explanation: Ikhandlela elibomvu livala ngaphansi kwalapho livule khona, ngakho amahlanu elandelana asho izikhathi zokuhweba ezinhlanu zokwehla. Umbala ukutshela ukuthi inani liya kuphi, hhayi ukuthi lishintshe kangakanani.
options: Isheya belikhuphuka izinsuku ezi-5
Isheya beliwohloka izinsuku ezi-5
Inani lesheya alishintshanga

7.title: I-Volume Nokuthi Ikutshelani
7.content:
I-volume = ukuthi mangaki amasheya athengwe futhi athengiswa ngosuku. Cabanga ngayo njengokubukwa kwevidiyo ye-TikTok.

🔊 I-volume EPHEZULU = abantu abaningi bayahweba. Uma inani lishintsha nge-volume ephezulu, kuwuphawu oluqinile, olwethembeka kakhudlwana, njengevidiyo edlanga ngempela, hhayi ngamabhothi.

🔇 I-volume EPHANSI = bambalwa kuphela abahwebayo. Amanani angashintsha ngendlela exakayo uma i-volume iphansi, njengevidiyo ebukwe abantu aba-3 kodwa yabelwana ngephutha.

Hlola njalo i-volume uma ubona inani lishintsha kakhulu. Ikutshela ukuthi lolo shintsho lungolwangempela noma lungumsindo nje!

quiz.q: Isheya le-{telco} likhuphuke ngo-5% namuhla, kodwa i-volume iphansi kakhulu. Kufanele ucabangeni?
quiz.explanation: I-volume ikhombisa ukuthi kunokuqiniseka okungakanani ngemuva koshintsho. Ukweqa okukhulu okwenzeke ngokuhweba okuncane kakhulu kungaphenduka kalula njengoba kwenzeka, ngakho hlola i-volume ngaphambi kokukholwa ukuthi inani ligqashule ngempela.
options: Nakanjani leli yithuba elikhulu, thenga manje!
I-volume ephansi ihlala isho ukuthi inani lizoqhubeka likhuphuka
Lolu shintsho lungase lungathembeki, i-volume ephansi ilenza libe nokusolisa

8.title: Ukusekelwa Nokumelana
8.content:
Cabanga inani lesheya njengebhola eligxumayo:

🧱 UKUSEKELWA = phansi lapho ibhola ligxuma khona libuyele phezulu. Inani liyehla lehle, kodwa njalo uma lifika kuleli zinga, liyagxuma libuyele phezulu. Abathengi abaningi bavela lapha.

🪟 UKUMELANA = uphahla ibhola elishaya kulo. Njalo uma inani likhuphukela kuleli zinga, liyaphindiselwa phansi. Abathengisi abaningi bakhipha inzuzo yabo lapha.

Abahwebi basebenzisa la mazinga njengebalazwe lomdlalo: thenga eduze kwaphansi, thengisa eduze kophahla. Uma inani ekugcineni lidabula ukumelana, livame ukukhuphuka ngokushesha. Uma lidabula ukusekelwa, zilungiselele ukwehla! 💥

Esinye isexwayiso esiqotho: la mazinga adwetshwa ngabantu ababuka amagrafu, akuyona imithetho okumele imakethe iyilandele. Isheya lingadabula 'ukusekelwa' liqhubeke lehla. 📉

quiz.q: Isheya ligxume labuyela phezulu ku-{c}50 izikhathi ezintathu ngaphandle kokwehlela ngaphansi kwalo. Kubizwa ngani u-{c}50?
quiz.explanation: Phansi okuqhubeka kuhlonishwa kuwukusekelwa; uphahla oluqhubeka luphindisela inani emuva kuwukumelana. Akukho kulokhu okuyisithembiso, kodwa kokubili kufanele ukwazi ngaphambi kokuthenga.
options: Izinga lokusekelwa
Izinga lokumelana
Inani lophahla

9.title: Ukusabalalisa Utshalomali
9.content:
Cabanga ukuthi uchitha YONKE i-data yakho ku-app eyodwa yokubukela. Bese leyo app iyaphuka. Usale ungenalutho. 😩

Kodwa uma usabalalisa i-data yakho ku-WhatsApp, ku-YouTube NAKUYO i-app yakho yokubukela, eyodwa ephukayo ayonakalisi usuku lwakho lonke.

Kuyafana notshalomali! Uma ufaka YONKE imali yakho esheyeni elilodwa bese liwohloka, ulahlekelwa yikho konke. Kodwa uma uyisabalalisa ku-{telco} (ezokuxhumana), ku-{retail} (ezitolo), ku-{tech} (ezobuchwepheshe), kanye naku-ETF, khona-ke ukuwohloka kwelilodwa akubulali yonke i-portfolio yakho. Leli su lokusabalalisa libizwa ngokuthi UKUSABALALISA UTSHALOMALI. 💼

quiz.q: Une-{c}500 ozowutshala. Iyiphi kulezi ehlakaza ubungozi bakho ngempela?
quiz.explanation: Izitolo ezinhlanu zezingubo zonke zikhuphuka futhi zehle ngenxa yento efanayo, ngakho imali ehlakazwe kuzo cishe ayihlakazekile nhlobo. Imikhakha ehlukene ihlangabezana nezinkinga ngezikhathi ezahlukene, futhi yilokho okuvimba ukuthi umphumela owodwa omubi ukuthathele konke.
options: U-{c}100 ngamunye ezitolo ezinhlanu ezahlukene zezingubo
U-{c}100 ngamunye emikhakheni emihlanu ehlukene
Yonke i-{c}500 enkampanini eyodwa oyithanda kakhulu

10.title: Ubungozi Nomvuzo
10.desc: Kungani inzuzo enkulu isho ubungozi obukhulu
10.content:
Uke wathenga ibhokisi eliyimfihlo? Ungathola into emangalisayo, noma udoti nje. Lokho kuwubungozi obuphezulu / umvuzo ophezulu.

Ukutshala imali kusebenza ngendlela efanayo:

✅ UBUNGOZI OBUNCANE, UMVUZO OMNCANE: Njenge-{retail}. Inkampani enkulu, esungulwe kahle. Imali yakho ivame ukukhula kancane kancane futhi ngokuzinzile. Qaphela 'obuncane', hhayi 'obungekho'. Nezinkampani ezinkulu ziyawa.

🎲 UBUNGOZI OBUKHULU, UMVUZO OMKHULU: Njengenkampani encane kakhulu yezimayini esanda kuqala. Ingakhula ngo-10x, noma inyamalale. Njengalelo bhokisi eliyimfihlo.

Ngaphambi kokutshala imali kunoma yini, buza njalo: 'Yini embi kunazo zonke engenzeka?' Uma ungakwazi ukumelana nokuyilahla, ungabuthathi lobo bungozi!

quiz.q: Uhlamvu lwemali (coin) okungekho owake waluzwa luthembisa inzuzo engu-500%. Isithembiso esikhulu kangako sikutshelani ngempela?
quiz.explanation: Ubungozi nomvuzo yimikhawulo emibili yenduku efanayo. Akekho onikeza u-500% mahhala, ngakho ubukhulu besithembiso empeleni bukala ukuthi lonke inani linganyamalala kalula kangakanani. Ngaphambi kokufaka imali kunoma yini, buza ukuthi isimo esibi kunazo zonke sibukeka kanjani nokuthi ungaphila naso yini.
options: Kuyithuba elihle imakethe yonke engalibonanga ngandlela thile
Uma isithembiso sikhulu, abantu abangemuva kwaso bazimisele kakhulu
Ithuba lokulahlekelwa yikho konke likhulu njengesithembiso

11.title: Isikhathi Eside Nesifushane
11.content:
🏃 UKUHWEBA ISIKHATHI ESIFUSHANE: Ukuthenga nokuthengisa phakathi kwezinsuku noma amasonto ukubamba izinguquko ezisheshayo zamanani. Ukucindezeleka okukhulu, kudinga isikhathi eside usesikrinini. Kufana nokuzama ukuqagela ukuthi ubani ozowina umdlalo ngamunye ethoneni.

🧘 UKUTSHALA IMALI ISIKHATHI ESIDE: Ukuthenga amasheya bese uwabambelela iminyaka. Udlula ezikhathini ezimbi bese uvumela imali yakho ikhule. Kufana nokubheja ukuthi yiliphi iqembu elizowina isizini yonke. Awethuki ngemuva komdlalo owodwa omubi.

Ucwaningo lwama-akhawunti okuhweba angempela luhlala luthola iphethini efanayo: uma abantu behweba njalo, bavame ukwenza kabi kakhulu uma izindleko sezibaliwe.

Futhi isikhathi siwukuphela kwenzuzo engeke ithengwe kamuva. Unyaka ngamunye imali ihlala itshaliwe ungomunye unyaka wokuthi ukukhula okuhlanganisiwe kusebenze. ⏳

quiz.q: Abantu ababili bathenga amasheya afanayo ngemali efanayo. Omunye uyangena aphume njalo ngesonto, omunye uwayeka nje iminyaka eyishumi. Ucwaningo lwama-akhawunti angempela luhlala luthola ini?
quiz.explanation: Ukuhweba ngakunye kunezindleko, futhi lezo zindleko ziyaphuma noma ukuhweba kuphumelele noma kungaphumelelanga. Ucwaningo ngemva kocwaningo lwama-akhawunti okuhweba angempela luthola iphethini efanayo: uma abantu behweba njalo, bagcina besemuva kakhulu. Ukuyeka imali ngokuthula akubona ubuvila, kuwuhlelo olushibhile.
options: Lowo omatasa uvame ukusala ngemuva uma izindleko sezibaliwe
Lowo omatasa uvame ukuwina, ngoba umzamo uyavuzwa lapha
Bagcina belingana, ngoba babebambe amasheya afanayo ncamashi

12.title: I-{dcaTitle}
12.content:
Nasi isu elilula kangangokuthi cishe alizwakali njengesu, futhi lisusa umbuzo onzima kunayo yonke ekutshaleni imali:

Tshala inani ELIFANAYO nyanga zonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi amanani aphezulu noma aphansi. Kufana nokubeka eceleni u-{c}100 emalini yakho yosuku lokuzalwa noma kwimali oyiphiwayo nyanga zonke.

📉 Uma amanani ePHANSI → u-{c}100 wakho uthenga amasheya AMANINGI
📈 Uma amanani ePHEZULU → u-{c}100 wakho uthenga amasheya AMANCANE

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindleko zakho eziphakathi nendawo esheyeni ngalinye ziyalingana, futhi uzithola 'uthenga uma kwehlile' ngaphandle kokuzama! Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi {dcaTitle} ({dcaAbbrev}). Kususa imizwa ekutshaleni imali ngoba awusoze wadinga ukunquma ukuthi 'ingabe MANJE yisikhathi esifanele?' Uyazibophezela nje bese uyaqhubeka! 💪

Iqiniso eliqondile: lokhu ngeke kuhlale kungcono kunokufaka inqwaba yemali ngasikhathi sinye. Okwenzayo ukwakha uhlelo ongakwazi ukunamathela kulo ngempela.

quiz.q: Ufaka u-200 NT lapho isheya libiza u-100 NT. Bese isheya liyawohloka, futhi u-200 NT wakho olandelayo ungena ku-25 NT. Hudula uye ezindlekweni zakho eziphakathi nendawo esheyeni ngalinye kulezi zinkokhelo ezimbili.
quiz.explanation: U-200 NT wakho wokuqala wathenga amasheya angu-2 ngo-100 NT. U-200 NT wakho wesibili wathenga amasheya angu-8 ngo-25 NT. Lokho kungu-400 NT ngamasheya angu-10, ngakho ngu-40 NT ngalinye. Qaphela ukuthi akukho eduze nakancane nophakathi kwala manani amabili: imali efanayo ngokuzenzakalelayo ithenga okuningi uma izinto zishibhile, futhi yilokho okwehlisa izindleko zakho eziphakathi nendawo.

13.title: Izinsana Zemali 💸
13.content:
Cabanga ukuthi unomshini othengisa ukudla. Njalo ngesonto abantu bathenga ukudla emshinini WAKHO, bese uqoqa imali, ngenxa nje yokuthi ungumnikazi. Awuzange wenze lutho olwengeziwe!

Yilokho okwenziwa amadividendi. Sithi izinsana zemali 🍼 ngoba imali yakho ngempela izala izinsana: izinkokhelo ezincane ezingena ku-akhawunti yakho ngenxa nje yokuthi unamasheya.

Izinkampani ezinkulu ezinjenge-{divPayers} zikhokha izinsana zemali njalo. Uma unamasheya amaningi, ziba zinkulu nezinsana zakho!

⚠️ AZIQINISEKISIWE. Inkampani inquma ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi izokhokha yini, futhi ingayinciphisa idividendi noma iyimise nya uma ibhizinisi lingahambi kahle. Inkokhelo enkulu kulo nyaka akulona isithembiso salo nyaka ozayo.

Futhi uma uphinda utshale lezo zinsana ukuthenga amasheya AMANINGI... iqoqo lakho elilandelayo liba likhulu nakakhulu. Kuwumjikelezo omuhle 🔁

quiz.q: I-{bank} ikukhokhela u-{c}5 ngesheya ngalinye onalo, ngaphandle kokuthi uthengise lutho. Leyo nkokhelo ibizwa ngokuthini?
quiz.explanation: Idividendi iyingxenye yenzuzo yenkampani enikezwa abantu abangabanikazi bayo. Le app iyibiza ngezinsana zemali. Ugcina wonke amasheya obunawo, futhi imali isangena ku-akhawunti yakho. Nokho ayithenjisiwe, futhi inkampani ingayinciphisa noma iyimise noma nini uma ibhizinisi lingahambi kahle.
options: Idividendi, ingxenye yenzuzo
Inzalo, efana naleyo ekhokhwa i-akhawunti yokonga
Ibhonasi yokwethembeka ngokuba yikhasimende

14.title: Inzalo Ehlanganisiwe
14.desc: Indlela imali yakho ekhula ngayo ngokwayo
14.content:
Nayi imfihlo yemali enamandla kunazo zonke ozake uyifunde. Usukulungele? 👀

Utshala u-{c}1,000 ngo-10% ngonyaka:
• Unyaka 1: {c}1,000 → {c}1,100 (uzuze u-{c}100)
• Unyaka 2: {c}1,100 → {c}1,210 (uzuze u-{c}110, ngaphezu konyaka 1!)
• Unyaka 3: {c}1,210 → {c}1,331 (uzuze u-{c}121)

Manje usuzuza inzalo ku-NZALO yakho. Ibhola leqhwa liya likhula minyaka yonke ngaphandle kokuthi wengeze lutho. Ngemva kweminyaka engu-30 ngo-10%? Lowo {c}1,000 uba ngu-{c}17,449! 🤯

Uzozwa abantu bekubiza ngokuthi 'isimangaliso sesishiyagalombili somhlaba' bethi kwashiwo ngu-Einstein. Abukho ubufakazi bangempela bokuthi wake wakusho, kodwa izibalo yizo ezibalulekile, futhi izibalo ziyiqiniso. Qala usemncane, bese isikhathi sikwenzela umsebenzi onzima.

quiz.q: Ufaka u-2,000 NT ngo-10% ngonyaka futhi awusoze wawuthinta. Hudula uye kulokho okubiza khona ngemva kweminyaka emithathu.
quiz.explanation: Unyaka wokuqala wengeza u-200 NT, okwenza u-2,200. Unyaka wesibili uthatha u-10% ka-2,200, ngakho wengeza u-220 bese kuba ngu-2,420. Unyaka wesithathu wengeza u-242 bese kufika ku-2,662. Unyaka ngamunye u-10% ubalwa enqwabeni enkulu, yingakho ukwengeza u-200 kathathu bese uma ku-2,600 kungafinyeleli.

15.title: Ukuhlanganisa Namasheya
15.desc: Ukuphinda utshale izinsana zemali ukuze kukhule
15.content:
Uyazikhumbula izinsana zemali (amadividendi)? Nakhu lapho kuqala khona ukuba mnandi 🤯

Okujwayelekile: Uzuza u-{c}50 ezinsaneni zemali → uwuchithe ekudleni → sekuphelile.

Ukuhlakanipha: Uzuza u-{c}50 ezinsaneni zemali → uthenge amasheya AMANINGI → ngokulandelayo uthole izinsana zemali EZININGI → uthenge amasheya amaningi nakakhulu → ibhola leqhwa liya 🔝

Lokhu ukuhlanganisa okusetshenziswe emasheyeni. Bala izibalo: faka inani elifanayo nyanga zonke iminyaka engu-30 ngenzuzo ephakathi nendawo engu-10%, bese ugcina unokuphindwe KAYISITHUPHA kwalokho okufakile ngempela. Cishe izingxenye ezinhlanu kweziyisithupha zaleyo nqwaba ukukhula: imali ongazange uyisebenzele, uyonge noma uyifake.

Esikhathini eside, amadividendi aphinde atshalwa enze ingxenye enkulu yenzuzo yonke yabatshalizimali. Yingakho izinkampani 'ezidinayo' ezikhokha amadividendi zigcina zingadinisi nhlobo 💰

Yingakho ukuqala uneminyaka engu-13 noma engu-14 KUKUHLE KAKHULU. Unemijikelezo eminingi yokuphindwa kabili ngaphambi kwakho kunacishe wonke umuntu!

17.title: Ama-Market Order vs Ama-Limit Order
17.content:
Zimbili izindlela eziyinhloko zokuthenga isheya:

⚡ I-MARKET ORDER: 'Thenga manje nganoma yiliphi inani elikhona.' Kufana nokufaka enqoleni bese ukhokha ngokushesha ku-{shop}. Uyithola ngokushesha, kodwa inani oligcina ukhokha yilona imakethe ekunika lona, futhi lingehluka kulelo obulibona esikrinini.

🎯 I-LIMIT ORDER: 'Thenga kuphela uma inani lehlela ku-{c}X.' Kufana nokufaka into ohlwini lwakho lwezifiso ku-{shop} bese ulinda ukuthengiswa ngentengo ephansi. Wena ulawula inani, kodwa lokho kuthengiselana kungenzeka kungenzeki nhlobo.

Ama-limit order akunika ukulawula inani. Ama-market order akunika isiqiniseko sokuthi kuyaphumelela. Awukwazi ukuba nakho kokubili! 💸

I-limit order isebenza ngendlela efanayo uma UTHENGISA, ibheke kolunye uhlangothi nje. Unalo isheya, ubeka inani ongajabula ukulithengisa ngalo, futhi uma likhuphukela lapho, i-app ikuthengisela lona. Uma uthenga, ubeka inani ELINGAPHANSI kwalapho likhona manje. Uma uthengisa, ubeka inani ELINGAPHEZULU. Umqondo ofanayo, uhlangothi oluphambene. 🔁

quiz.q: I-{tech} ihweba ngo-{c}200. Ungajabula ukuba nayo, kodwa kuphela ngo-{c}180 noma ngaphansi. Usebenzisa yiphi?
quiz.explanation: I-market order iphumelela ngokushesha nganoma yiliphi inani elikhona ngaleso sikhathi. I-limit order ibeka inani lakho bese ilinda, ngakho i-app iyakubukela esikhundleni sakho. Uma inani ozolamukela libaluleke kakhulu kunokungena ngokushesha, yiyo ofuna yona.

19.title: Ama-Stop-Loss Order
19.content:
I-stop-loss kufana nokubeka umkhawulo wokuthi ungakwazi ukulahlekelwa kangakanani: inetha lokuphepha olibeka kusenesikhathi.

Isibonelo: Uthenga amasheya e-{telco} ngo-{c}100 ngalinye. Unquma ukuthi AWUSOZE wafuna ukulahlekelwa ngaphezu kuka-15%. Ngakho ubeka i-stop-loss ku-{c}85.

Uma i-{telco} yehlela ku-{c}85 → kuqhuma i-oda lokuthengisa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Akudingeki ubukele, futhi akudingeki wenze isinqumo ngesikhathi wethukile.

Nansi ingxenye abantu abayiphutha kuyo. Inani le-stop-loss NJALO lingaphansi kwenani lanamuhla. Kumele kube njalo, ngoba inani kumele lehle ukuze lifike kulo. Uma ulibeka ngaphezu kwenani lanamuhla, selivele liyiqiniso, ngakho lithengisa ngomzuzwana olibeka ngawo, ngenani lanamuhla. Lokho kuwukuthengisa, hhayi inetha lokuphepha.

Ungakuxubi ne-limit sell. Kokubili kuthengisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngenani olikhethile. Umehluko yindlela: i-stop-loss iqhuma lapho inani LEHLELA enanini lakho, i-limit sell iqhuma lapho inani LIKHUPHUKELA enanini lakho. Ukuzivikela → inani lakho liya ngaphansi. Ukubeka inani lakho → inani lakho liya ngaphezulu. Zibuze ukuthi wenza yiphi ngaphambi kokuthayipha. 🧭

⚠️ Okubalulekile: i-stop-loss iqalisa UKUTHENGISA, ayiqinisekisi INANI. Uma izindaba ezimbi zifika ebusuku bese isheya livula ku-{c}70 lingakaze lihwetshwe ku-{c}85, i-oda lakho ligcwaliswa ngalokho imakethe ezokukhokha ngempela. Lokho kungaba ngaphansi kakhulu kwezinga olibekile.

Uma ungenayo nhlobo i-stop-loss, ungase ubambelele wethemba ukuthi lizolulama... bese ubuka lehlela ku-{c}20. 😬

Iseluleko: Nquma njalo ukulahlekelwa kwakho okuphezulu NGAPHAMBI kokuthenga. Ungavumeli imizwa yenze leso sinqumo ngesikhathi inani selehla kakhulu! 🧘

quiz.q: Uthenga ngo-200 NT futhi unquma ukuthi awuzimisele ukulahlekelwa ngaphezu kuka-15% kulo. Hudula uye enanini lapho i-stop-loss yakho ifanele khona.
quiz.explanation: U-15% ka-200 NT ungu-30 NT, ngakho indawo yakho yokuphuma ingu-30 ngaphansi kwalapho uthenge khona, ku-170 NT. I-stop-loss iya ngaphansi kwenani lanamuhla, ngoba inani kumele lehle ukuze lifike kuyo. Uma uyibeka ngaphezulu, isivele iyiqiniso, ngakho ithengisa ngomzuzu oyibeka ngawo, futhi lokho kuwukuthengisa kunokuba yinetha lokuphepha.

20.title: Nini Ukuthenga Nokuthengisa
20.content:
Iphutha elikhulu elenziwa abatshalizimali abasha? Ukuthenga uma wonke umuntu ejabule nokuthengisa uma wonke umuntu ethukile. Lokho kuyimpela okuphambene nalokho okusebenzayo. 🤦

📱 Uma iqembu lakho lengxoxo ligcwalisa ngo-'THENGA LELI SHEYA MANJE!!!!' → ukujabula sekuvamise ukuba sekufakiwe enanini. Usuphuzile.

😱 Uma wonke umuntu ethengisa ngokwethuka → ngezinye izikhathi lelo lithuba lokuthenga ngentengo ephansi. Ngezinye izikhathi inani liyaqhubeka lehla omunye unyaka wonke. Akekho okhalisa insimbi lapho sekufike phansi.

Iyiphi imfihlo? Yiba nohlelo NGAPHAMBI kokuba utshale imali:
• Ngiyithengelani le nto? (ucwaningo, hhayi ukujabula)
• Ngizothengisa ngaliphi inani uma likhuphuka? (thatha inzuzo)
• Ngizothengisa ngaliphi inani uma lehla? (i-stop-loss)

Namathela ohlelweni lwakho. Ungavumeli imizwa yakho ithathe indawo yesu lakho! 💪

quiz.q: Lonke iqembu lakho lengxoxo lidumisa isheya eselikhuphuke ngo-80% kule nyanga. Yini into ehlakaniphile ongayenza?
quiz.explanation: Ngesikhathi isheya selikuwo wonke amaqembu engxoxo, iningi lokukhuphuka selivele lenzekile, futhi abantu abafika sekwephuzile bathenga kubantu abathatha inzuzo yabo. Zibhekele inkampani ngokwakho. Isixuku esinomsindo asifani nesixuku esinembile.
options: Thenga manje, ngaphambi kokuthi inani likweqe
Thengisa amanye amasheya akho bese ufaka konke lapha
Zihlolele inkampani ngokwakho ngaphambi kokunquma

🔴 I-small cap: izinkampani ezincane kakhulu. Zingakhula ngokushesha NOMA ziwohloke kabi.

quiz.explanation: I-market cap yinani lesheya liphindwe ngenani lamasheya. Inkampani A ibiza izigidi ezingu-5 eziphindwe ngo-{c}200, okungu-{c}1,000 wezigidi. Inkampani B kufanele ifinyelele kulelo nani elifanayo ngo-{c}10 isheya ngalinye, ngakho idinga amasheya ayizigidi ezingu-100, aphindwe kangamashumi amabili. Inani lesheya eliphansi alikutsheli lutho ngobukhulu benkampani.

22.title: I-P/E Ratio Ichaziwe
22.desc: Ingabe isheya libiza kakhulu noma lishibhile?
22.content:
I-P/E ratio (Inani Kunenzuzo) ikutshela ukuthi ukhokha malini nge{cName} ngalinye lenzuzo yenkampani.

📐 Ifomula: Inani Lesheya ÷ Inzuzo Ngesheya Ngalinye = I-P/E Ratio

Cabanga ngayo njengenani lecezu ngalinye lepizza 🍕

Uma ipizza A ibiza u-{c}80 ngamacezu angu-8 = {c}10/icezu
Uma ipizza B ibiza u-{c}100 ngamacezu angu-5 = {c}20/icezu

Ipizza A ishibhile ecezwini ngalinye. Umqondo ofanayo ngamasheya:
• I-P/E ephansi (ngaphansi kuka-10) = kungenzeka kuyithuba elihle, NOMA imakethe ilindele ukuthi inzuzo yayo IZOKWEHLA. I-P/E ephansi ingumbuzo, akuyona impendulo.
• I-P/E ephezulu (ngaphezu kuka-25) = imakethe ilindele ukukhula okukhulu esikhathini esizayo. Inkampani kufanele ikulethe ngempela lokho.

Qhathanisa njalo i-P/E nezinye izinkampani emkhakheni ofanayo. Ungaqhathanisi i-P/E yebhange neyenkampani yobuchwepheshe!

quiz.q: Inkampani A ine-P/E engu-8. Inkampani B (emkhakheni ofanayo) ine-P/E engu-30. Kusho ukuthini lokhu?
quiz.explanation: I-P/E ephansi isho ukukhokha okuncane ngeyunithi ngayinye yenzuzo, okungasho ithuba elihle noma inkampani esenkingeni. Isilinganiso siphakamisa umbuzo; asiwuphenduli.
options: Inkampani A ishibhile enzuzweni ngayinye, kodwa thola ukuthi KUNGANI ngaphambi kokuthenga
Inkampani B ihlala iwutshalomali olungcono kulezi zombili
I-P/E ratio ayisizi nhlobo ezinqumweni zokutshala imali

23.title: Ukufunda Imiphumela Yenkampani
23.content:
Njalo ngezinyanga ezimbalwa izinkampani zishicilela 'ikhadi lazo lemiphumela' (njalo ngekota kwamanye amamakethe, kabili ngonyaka kwamanye), futhi kushintsha amanani amasheya KAKHULU. Nakhu okumele ukubheke:

📊 IMALI ENGENAYO: Yonke imali engena ngokuthengisa. Njengenani lonke elingene esitolo esincane.
💰 INZUZO ESELE: Okusele NGEMVA kokukhokha zonke izindleko. Imali yangempela esele ekupheleni kosuku.
📈 I-EPS (Inzuzo Ngesheya Ngalinye): Inzuzo ihlukaniswe ngenani lamasheya. Ukuthi isheya ngalinye lizuze malini.

Izimpawu ezinhle: Imali engenayo IKHUPHUKILE + Inzuzo IKHUPHUKILE + I-EPS iyakhula = 🟢 inani livame ukukhuphuka
Izimpawu ezimbi: Imali engenayo YEHLILE + Inzuzo iyehla = 🔴 inani livame ukwehla

Okukodwa okufanele ukwazi: okushintsha inani ngempela umphumela uma uqhathaniswa nalokho imakethe EBIKULINDELE. Izibalo ezinhle ezingaphansi kwalokho obekulindelwe zingasehlisa isheya.

Inkampani ingaba nemali eningi engenayo kodwa ingabi nanzuzo (izindleko eziphezulu). Bheka njalo KOKUBILI!

quiz.q: I-{bank} ibika ukuthi imali engenayo ikhuphuke ngo-15% kodwa inzuzo yehle ngo-20% ngenxa yezindleko eziphezulu. Ingabe lolu wuphawu oluhle noma olubi?
quiz.explanation: Imali engenayo yilokho okungenile, inzuzo yilokho okusele. Lapha izindleko zikhuphuka ngokushesha kunokuthengisa, ngakho inkampani yenza ibhizinisi eliningi kodwa igcina okuncane kulo. Lokho kuyisexwayiso sangempela, kodwa akukhona ukuwa, futhi into elandelayo okufanele uyithole ukuthi kungani izindleko zikhuphukile.
options: Kuyakhathaza, ngoba bathengisa kakhulu kodwa bagcina okuncane kukho
Kuqinile, ngoba imali engenayo ekhuphukayo yiyona ebaluleke ngempela
Kubi kakhulu, ngoba inzuzo eyehlayo isho ukuthi inkampani iyahluleka

Ama-ETF ngokuvamile ashibhile, alula futhi asabalele kakhulu kunokukhetha amasheya ngokwakho. Abaphathi bezimali abaningi abangochwepheshe abakwazi ukuwanqoba! 🤯

Akulona igama elikhulu kunawo wonke kuphela, futhi akukona ukheshi olinde imiyalelo yakho.

Bacele ukuthi baqale bakuthumelele i-imeyili evela ekhelini elisemthethweni, bese wabelana ngaso

38.title: Umphathi We-crypto
38.content:
Sekuyisikhathi sendaba wonke umuntu ayicaphunayo kodwa engekho oyixoxa kahle.

Ekuqaleni kuka-2017, i-Bitcoin eyodwa yayibiza cishe u-$1,000. NgoDisemba 2024 yeqa u-$100,000 okokuqala ngqa. Ukuthenga kuka-$1,000, okwabanjwa indlela yonke, kwaba cishe u-$100,000. Lokho kuphindwe ka-100x. 🤯

Manje ingxenye eshiywa ngaphandle ukuphakanyiswa: ukuze uthole lokho kuphindwa ka-100x kwakumele udlule ekuwohlokeni okubili okubuhlungu, okunye cishe okungu-84% nokunye cishe okungu-77%, ubuke imali yakho incipha IMINYAKA ngaphandle kokuthengisa. Cishe akekho owakwazi. Abantu abaningi bathenga kuphezulu, bethuka ekuwohlokeni, bathengisa kuphansi.

Futhi kuyo yonke i-Bitcoin eyodwa kunezinkulungwane zezinhlamvu ezafa zaya ku-zero. Ukukhetha ozowina kusenesikhathi kubukeka kulula uma ubheka emuva kuphela. Lokho kubizwa ngokuthi ukuchema kwabasindile (survivorship bias), futhi kuyinkohliso ebiza kakhulu kwi-crypto.

Isifundo sangempela somshini wesikhathi: ezinhlanjini ezasinda, ukubekezela kwanqoba ukuqagela isikhathi. Kodwa uthola KAMUVA kuphela ukuthi yiziphi izinhlamvu ezisindayo, yingakho ukusabalalisa kunqoba ukukhetha okukodwa kweqhawe, futhi yingakho AKEKHO owazi ikusasa. Ngisho nomphathi. 🐉
38.bossVictory: Isahluko se-crypto sinqotshiwe. Manje usuwazi okwengeziwe kunabantu abadala abaningi. 🐉

quiz.q: Izinkulungwane zezinhlamvu zethulwa kanye ne-Bitcoin, futhi eziningi manje azisabizi cishe lutho. Kungani u-"khetha nje i-Bitcoin elandelayo" kubukeka kulula kangaka uma ubheka emuva?
quiz.explanation: Kusakhulunywa kuphela ngabasindile, ngakho ukukhetha abawinayo kubukeka kulula kakhulu uma ubheka emuva kunalokho okwakunjalo ngaleso sikhathi. Izinkulungwane ezehluleka azishiyanga mkhondo endabeni.
options: Ngoba abawinile yibona kuphela abasakhulunywa ngabo, kanti ezafa zanyamalala endabeni
Ngoba izinhlamvu ezingcono zicaca kusukela ekuqaleni kunoma ubani ofunda ngazo ngokwanele
Ngoba izinhlamvu eziningi zigcina zilunga kunoma ubani obekezela ngokwanele ukuzibamba iminyaka
Ngoba ochwepheshe bayibikezela kahle i-Bitcoin ngo-2010 futhi babikezele bonke abawinile kusukela lapho

39.title: Iyini Ngempela I-Blockchain?
39.content:
Susa ukuphakanyiswa bese i-blockchain ilula ngokumangazayo: incwadi yamarekhodi eyabelwanwayo amakhompyutha ayizinkulungwane agcina amakhophi afanayo ncamashi kuyo.

Uma umuntu ethumela i-crypto, lokho kuhwebelana kungena 'ebhulokini' kanye namakhulu amanye. Ibhuloko livalwa ngezibalo bese lixhunywa ebhulokini elandulele. Yingakho: ibhuloko. Iketanga. ⛓️

Kungani umuntu enendaba? Ngenxa yalokho okwenza kwenzeke:

✅ Akekho ongashintsha umlando ngokuthula. Ukushintsha ibhuloko elidala kungasho ukwenza kabusha wonke amabhuloko alandelayo kumakhompyutha ayizinkulungwane ngasikhathi sinye.
✅ Ayikho inkampani eyodwa noma uhulumeni oyiphethe. Yinethiwekhi yamakhompyutha eyiphetha ndawonye.
✅ Noma ubani angahlola irekhodi. Konke ukuhwebelana kwe-Bitcoin okwake kwenziwa kuyabonakala emphakathini.

Lobo ubuchwepheshe obusha ngempela. Futhi AKUYONA imali yomlingo. Irekhodi eliphelele lohlamvu olungenanani lusalona uhlamvu olungenanani. Ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungokoqobo akwenzi ukuthi zonke izinhlamvu ezakhelwe phezu kwabo zibe nenani. 🧠

quiz.q: Kungani kunzima kangaka ukushintsha ngasese ukuhwebelana okudala ku-blockchain?
quiz.explanation: Ibhuloko ngalinye livalwe laxhunywa kwelandulele, ngakho ukubhala kabusha elidala kusho ukubhala kabusha wonke amabhuloko alandelayo, kumakhompyutha ayizinkulungwane, ngokushesha kunokuthi inethiwekhi yengeze amasha. Yilokho okwenza irekhodi lingapheli ngokoqobo.
options: Wonke amabhuloko alandelayo kuzodingeka enziwe kabusha
Ushintsho ngalunye kumele lugunyazwe nguhulumeni
Wonke amarekhodi amadala kunenyanga ayasulwa
Umdali wohlamvu ngalunye ugcina ukhiye oyimfihlo wokuhlela

40.title: I-Bitcoin Kanye Nakho Konke Okunye
40.content:
'I-crypto' akuyona into eyodwa. Umehluko ubaluleke kakhulu kunokufana:

₿ I-BITCOIN: eyokuqala. Inani layo ligcinwa ku-21 wezigidi zezinhlamvu unomphela, kubhalwe kukhodi, futhi izinga lezinhlamvu ezintsha lehla ngesigamu cishe njalo eminyakeni emine. (Kuzwakala kwaziwa? Ukwehla ngesigamu kwe-NOOB kuboleka lo mbono ncamashi.) Yonke inkulumo yayo iphathelene nokungatholakali kalula kanye nokuvikeleka.

⟠ I-ETHEREUM: ayilona kangako 'igolide ledijithali', iyi-'khompyutha yomhlaba'. Isebenzisa ama-smart contract, okuyizinhlelo ezizisebenzayo ngokwazo. Ama-app amaningi e-crypto akhelwe phezu kwayo noma phezu kwabancintisana nayo.

🪙 KONKE OKUNYE: izinkulungwane 'zama-altcoin'. Ambalwa axazulula izinkinga zangempela. Amaningi angamakhophi, ukuzama, noma ukuthatha imali. Isibalo esibuhlungu: iningi lezinhlamvu ezake zenziwa selifile noma alisenanani.

Isifundo: 'i-crypto iyakhuphuka' akukutsheli cishe lutho ngohlamvu OLUTHILE. Ngalunye lubheja ngokwalo, lunamathuba alo. 🎲

quiz.q: Yini inani eliphezulu lezinhlamvu ze-Bitcoin, futhi lingashintshwa kalula kangakanani?
quiz.explanation: Umkhawulo wezigidi ezingu-21 uyingxenye yemithetho esetshenziswa yikhompyutha ngayinye kunethiwekhi. Ukuwukhuphula kungadinga ukuthi cishe zonke zivume ukwenza lokho ezikuphethe kakade kube nenani elincane, yingakho umkhawulo uthathwa njengongaguquki.
options: Izigidi ezingu-100, futhi abambi bavota ngawo minyaka yonke
Izigidi ezingu-21, futhi ukuwukhuphula cishe akunakwenzeka
Isigidigidi esingu-1, futhi umdali angawushintsha
Awukho umkhawulo nhlobo, ngakho izinhlamvu ezintsha ziphrintwa unomphela

41.title: Ama-Stablecoin
41.content:
I-stablecoin yi-crypto eyakhelwe ukuthi ihlale ibiza inani elimisiwe, imvamisa idola elilodwa lase-US ncamashi. Abahwebi bayisebenzisa njengendawo yokupaka: thengisa izinhlamvu zakho eziguquguqukayo uzifake ku-stablecoin, bese imali yakho ime ndawonye ngesikhathi unquma isinyathelo esilandelayo.

Zihlala kanjani ku-$1? Umklamo oyinhloko ugcina amadola nempahla yangempela endaweni yokugcina, ukuze uhlamvu ngalunye lusekelwe yinto ethile. Wethemba noma ubani obambe lokho okugciniwe.

Nansi indaba yakho yesexwayiso: ama-stablecoin ANGAPHUKA. Sekwenzekile ngempela. Ngo-2022 i-stablecoin enkulu 'ye-algorithm', eyayisebenzisa izibalo ezihlakaniphile esikhundleni sokugcina okwangempela, yawohloka isuka ku-$1 yaya cishe kuziro ezinsukwini ezimbalwa futhi yashabalalisa amashumi ezigidigidi zamadola. 'Ukuzinza' kuyinhloso yomklamo, akusona isiqiniseko.

Umthetho ojwayelekile: uma indlela egcina into 'iphephile' ihlakaniphe kakhulu, kufanele uyibheke ngamehlo abukhali nakakhulu. 🔍

quiz.q: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-stablecoin?
quiz.explanation: Umsebenzi we-stablecoin ukuma ndawonye. Iyindawo yokupaka phakathi kokuhweba, hhayi into okulindeleke ukuthi ikhule.
options: Ukubamba inani elimisiwe, imvamisa u-$1, ukuze abahwebi babe nendawo ezinzile yokupaka
Ukukhula ngokushesha kune-Bitcoin ngokulandela yonke imakethe ye-crypto
Ukukhokha inzalo ngokuzenzakalelayo kunoma ubani oyigcine ku-wallet
Ukufihla ukuhwebelana kuwo wonke umuntu ngokuxuba irekhodi lomphakathi

42.title: I-crypto, Intela Nomthetho
42.content:
I-inthanethi igcwele abantu abakholelwa ukuthi i-crypto yimali engabonakali engenamithetho. Bavame ukukuthola ngendlela enzima. 😬

Okwangempela emazweni amaningi, kuhlanganise neNingizimu Afrika:

🧾 INZUZO IVAME UKUKHOKHELWA INTELA. Thengisa i-crypto ngaphezu kwalokho okukhokhile, bese isikhungo sentela ngokuvamile sifuna ingxenye yaso, njengasemasheyeni.

🪪 AMA-EXCHANGE AYAZI UKUTHI UNGUBANI. Amaplatifomu asemthethweni adinga ukuqinisekiswa kwe-ID (okuthiwa yi-KYC, Know Your Customer). Konke ukuhwebelana kubuye kubhalwe unomphela ku-blockchain uqobo, okuyinto ePHAMBENE nokungaziwa.

⚖️ ABALAWULI BABANDAKANYEKILE. ENingizimu Afrika, impahla ye-crypto ithathwa ngokusemthethweni njengemikhiqizo yezimali, okusho ukuthi amaplatifomu ayithengisayo kufanele alandele imithetho yezinsizakalo zezimali.

Akukho kulokhu okuyisizathu sokwethuka. KODWA kuyisizathu sokungamlaleli noma ubani othi 'imithetho ayisebenzi ku-crypto'. Iyasebenza, futhi ukwenza sengathi akunjalo kufaka abantu abadala enkingeni enkulu ngempela.

quiz.q: Umzala wakho uthi inzuzo ye-crypto ayibonakali esikhungweni sentela ngoba i-crypto ayaziwa ukuthi ingeyabani. Yini engalungile ngalokho?
quiz.explanation: Amaplatifomu asemthethweni aqinisekisa ukuthi ungubani ngaphambi kokuba uhwebe, futhi konke ukuhwebelana ku-blockchain kusobala kuwo wonke umuntu futhi kuhlala unomphela, okuphambene nokungaziwa. Inzuzo ngokuvamile ikhokhelwa intela, ngakho hlola imithetho lapho uhlala khona.
options: Ama-exchange ahlola i-ID, futhi amarekhodi asobala
Akukho lutho, i-crypto ayaziwa ngempela
I-crypto ikhokhelwa intela eMelika kuphela
Intela iqala uma usukhiphe isigidi

43.title: Ukuguquguquka Nemithetho Yokusinda
43.content:
Usuku olubi emakethe yamasheya lungu-3%. Usuku olubi ku-crypto lungu-20%. Ngisho ne-Bitcoin, 'umuntu omdala' we-crypto, seyilahlekelwe ngaphezu kuka-80% wenani layo izikhathi ezingaphezu kweyodwa yabuye yalulama. Izinhlamvu ezincane zivame ukulahlekelwa ngu-95% zingabuyi nhlobo.

Kungani kuyisiyaluyalu kangaka? I-crypto ihwetshwa 24/7 ngaphandle kwezivimbi zokuhweba, iningi layo lithengwa ngemali ebolekiwe ephoqwa ukuthi ithengiswe ekuwohlokeni, futhi amanani aqhutshwa yizindaba nemizwa kunemibiko yenzuzo.

Ngakho nansi imithetho yokusinda, ephindwa yiwo wonke umhwebi onolwazi:

1️⃣ Ungalokothi ufake imali ongakwazi ukuyilahlekelwa ngokuphelele.
2️⃣ Yenza izikhundla zakho zibe ngobukhulu obungavumeli inhlekelele eyodwa ikuqede.
3️⃣ Nquma indlela yakho yokuphuma NGAPHAMBI kokungena, usazolile.
4️⃣ I-FOMO ngumuzwa obiza kakhulu kwezezimali.

Zilolonge kuyo yomine ku-NoobTrader lapho ukulahlekelwa kungokomdlalo. Imikhuba yiwona mklomelo wangempela. 🏆

quiz.q: Yimuphi kulena ongumthetho wangempela wokusinda ezimakethe eziguquguqukayo?
quiz.explanation: Ukungalokothi ubeke engcupheni imali ongakwazi ukuyilahlekelwa yiwona mthetho owodwa okugcina usemdlalweni. Ukuphinda kabili ngemva kokulahlekelwa yindlela ama-akhawunti aphela ngayo.
options: Phinda kabili isikhundla sakho ngemva kokulahlekelwa ngakunye ukuze ukubuyise
Ungalokothi utshale imali ongakwazi ukuyilahlekelwa ngokuphelele
Ukuguquguquka kuthinta izinhlamvu ezincane kuphela, ngakho ezinkulu ziphephile
Hlala uthenga uma wonke umuntu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ethenga

44.title: Imijikelezo Yokuhaywa Ne-FOMO
44.content:
I-crypto ihamba ngemijikelezo yokuhaywa, futhi uma usuyibonile iphethini awusoze waphinde wehluleka ukuyibona:

📈 Isigaba 1: kwenzeka into yangempela. Abakholwayo bokuqala bathenga buthule.
🚀 Isigaba 2: amanani ayakhuphuka. Abezindaba bayaqaphela. Ifidi yakho igcwala abawinile.
🎪 Isigaba 3: ukuhlanya. Abashayeli bamatekisi banikeza amathiphu ezinhlamvu. Abantu bayaboleka ukuze bathenge. 'Kulokhu kwehlukile.'
💥 Isigaba 4: ukuwohloka. Abafike sekwephuzile, abathenga kuphezulu kakhulu, yibona abalahlekelwa kakhulu.
🕳️ Isigaba 5: ukuthula. Okuthunyelwe kwabawinile kuyanyamalala. Akekho okhuluma ngokulahlekelwa kwakhe.

Ukuqhakaza kwama-NFT ngo-2021 kwalandela lo mbhalo ncamashi: izinto zokuqoqwa zedijithali zithengiswa ngezigidi phezulu, kwathi eminyakeni embalwa kamuva eziningi zazingasabizi cishe lutho.

Iqhinga elinonya lakho konke ukuhlanya: lenza isikhathi ESIBI kakhulu sokuthenga sizwakale njengesikhathi ESIPHUTHUMA kakhulu sokuthenga. Uma kuzwakala kuphephe kakhulu ukungena, ngoba wonke umuntu esengenile, inzuzo elula ivamise ukuba isihambile. 🎯

quiz.q: Emjikelezweni ojwayelekile wokuhaywa, umuntu ovamile uzwa nini isifiso esinamandla kakhulu sokuthenga?
quiz.explanation: Isifiso sizwakala kakhulu uma indaba izwakala kakhulu, futhi indaba izwakala kakhulu ngemva kokuba inani selikhuphuke kakade. Ukuthi wonke umuntu usengenile yikho okwenza kuzwakale kuphephile, futhi yikho futhi okushiya kungekho muntu osasele ozothenga.
options: Ekuqaleni, lapho cishe kungekho muntu okhuluma ngakho
Phakathi nokuwohloka, lapho amanani esephansi
Eduze kwesiqongo, lapho wonke umuntu esengenile
Ayilandeli iphethini, isifiso siyazenzakalela

45.title: Ukufunda Ikhandlela
45.content: Ikhandlela ngalinye lixoxa indatshana ngezinombolo ezine kuphela: lapho inani livule khona, eliphezulu kakhulu elifinyelele kulo, eliphansi kakhulu elehlele kulo, nalapho livale khona. Umzimba oqinile usuka ekuvuleni uye ekuvaleni, futhi umbala ukutshela ukuthi ngubani owinile: oluhlaza lusho ukuthi ukuvala kuphelele ngaphezu kokuvula, obomvu busho ukuthi abathengisi balidonsele ngaphansi. Yilelo lonke iqhinga. Funda ukufunda ikhandlela elilodwa kahle bese wonke amagrafu emhlabeni ashintsha asuke ekubeni udonga lomsindo abe yindaba yemidwebo. 🟢

quiz.q: Leli khandlela liluhlaza. Likutshelani ngaleso sikhathi sokuhweba?
options: Inani livale liphansi kunalapho livule khona
Abantu abaningi bathengile kunalabo abathengisile, ngokuqinisekile
Inani livale liphezulu kunalapho livule khona
Inani alizange lehle nakancane ngaleso sikhathi

46.title: Izintambo Zixoxa Izindaba
46.content: Umzimba ukhombisa lapho isikhathi sivule futhi savala khona, kodwa izintambo zikhombisa uhambo lonke: yonke intengo impi eyafinyelela kuyo ngempela. Intambo ende isho ukuthi kwenzeke impi enkulu ngale kokuvula nokuvala, futhi uhlangothi olushiye intambo ngemuva yilona olwahlulwa kuleyo mpi. Intambo ende ngezansi? Abathengisi basunduze ngamandla babuye bahlulwa. Intambo ende ngenhla? Abathengi bafinyelele phezulu banqatshelwa. Umzimba uyisihloko, izintambo ziyinhlebo. 📏

quiz.q: Yini ngempela ekhonjiswa yimigqa emincane (izintambo) engenhla nengezansi komzimba?
options: Amanani aphezulu naphansi kunawo wonke ahwetshwe ngaleso sikhathi
Ukuvula nokuvala kwayizolo
Amanani ancamashi lapho ukuhwebelana okuningi kwenzeke khona
Isibikezelo sebanga lakusasa

47.title: I-Doji
47.content: Ngezinye izikhathi ikhandlela livula bese livala cishe ngenani elifanayo ncamashi, lishiye umzimba omncanyana onezintambo nhlangothi zombili. Lokho kuyi-doji, futhi kusho ukuthi ukudonsisana kuphele ngokulingana: abathengi nabathengisi badonse ngamandla isikhathi sonke kodwa akubanga khona uhlangothi oluwinile. Ngokwalo kuwukunyakazisa amahlombe nje. Ngemva kokukhuphuka okuqinile lingasikisela ukuthi umkhuba usukhathele, ngoba uhlangothi obeluwina ngokuzumayo luhlulekile ukushintsha inani. Yisisekelo esifanele ukuqashelwa, akusona neze isiqiniseko. 🤝

quiz.q: Ikhandlela elikhanyayo livule futhi lavala cishe ngenani elifanayo ncamashi. Libizwa ngani, futhi lisikiselani?
options: I-marubozu, uphawu lokuzimisela okuphelele ngakolunye uhlangothi
I-hammer, uphawu lokuthi abathengi bathathe izintambo futhi
Igebe, uphawu lokuthi ukuhweba kumile ebusuku
I-doji, uphawu lokungenqumi phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi

48.title: I-Hammer
48.content: Cabanga isikhathi esinzima: abathengisi bashaya inani phansi, bese abathengi belidonsela phezulu konke ngaphambi kokuvala. Okusala egrafini yi-hammer: umzimba omncane eduze kwaphezulu onentambo ende ngezansi okungenani ephindwe kabili ubukhulu bawo. Ngemva kokushelela kwehla, i-hammer isho ukuthi abathengisi bazamile ngesibhakela sabo esinamandla kunazo zonke kodwa asizange sishaye. Lokho kuvame ukukhomba ukuguquka okungenzeka. Okungenzeka, hhayi okuthenjisiwe, ngakho kuthathe njengesisekelo sokubukwa, hhayi njengomyalo wokuthenga. 🔨

quiz.q: Ngemva kokushelela kwehla, ikhandlela elikhanyayo lidwebe intambo ende ngezansi nomzimba omncane eduze kwaphezulu. Kuyini lokho?
options: I-shooting star, uphawu lokuthi abathengisi bathathe izintambo
I-hammer, uphawu lokuthi abathengi balwe ngamandla
I-doji, ukulingana okuphelele
Ubufakazi bokuthi umkhuba wokwehla usuphelile

49.title: I-Shooting Star
49.content: Yisithombe esibuyisiwe se-hammer. Ngemva kokukhuphuka okuqinile, abathengi bazama enye indawo ephakeme entsha, banqatshwe kabuhlungu, bese inani livala phansi eduze nalapho livule khona. Igrafu lidweba umzimba omncane ngezansi kwekhandlela onentambo ende ngenhla: i-shooting star. Kusho ukuthi abathengisi bagcine bevelile phezulu benamandla anele okuwina leso sikhathi. Ngemva kokukhuphuka okukhulu, lokho kunqatshwa kuvame ukuba nomthelela. Kuvame, hhayi njalo. 🌠

quiz.q: Ngemva kokukhuphuka okuqinile, ikhandlela elikhanyayo lagxumela phezulu bese livala eduze kwaphansi kwalo, lishiya intambo ende ngenhla. Kuyini lokho?
options: I-shooting star, uphawu lokuthi abathengisi bavele phezulu
I-hammer, uphawu lokuthi abathengi sebephethe futhi
I-marubozu eluhlaza, amandla okuthenga amsulwa
Isiqiniseko sokuthi inani lizowohloka kusasa

50.title: I-Marubozu
50.content: I-marubozu ngumzimba owodwa oqinile ongenazintambo nhlobo: inani livulile bese limasha ngakolunye uhlangothi isikhathi sonke lingabheki emuva. Ayikho impi, akukho ukungabaza, ukuzimisela okuphelele kohlangothi olulodwa. I-marubozu eluhlaza imemeza ukuzethemba kwabathengi, ebomvu imemeza okuphambene. Ziyivelakancane, yingakho kanye abahwebi beqaphela uma kuvela eyodwa. 💪

quiz.q: Ikhandlela elikhanyayo ngumzimba owodwa oqinile ongenazintambo nhlobo. Leso simo sikutshelani?
options: Akekho owahweba ngaleso sikhathi, ngakho lahlala lilingene
Imakethe yavala ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngalolo suku yalinqamula
Uhlangothi olulodwa lwalubambe izintambo kusukela ekuvuleni kuya ekuvaleni, ukuzimisela okuphelele
Abathengi nabathengisi babelingana ngokuphelele kwaze kwaba sekugcineni

51.title: I-Bullish Engulfing
51.content: Amakhandlela amabili, umyalezo owodwa. Kuqala ikhandlela elincane elibomvu, into ejwayelekile emkhubeni wokwehla. Bese kuba nomzimba omkhulu oluhlaza oligwinya ngokuphelele: ngesikhathi esisodwa, abathengi basule konke abathengisi abakuzuze ngosuku olwedlule, kwaze kwedlula. Uma lifika ngemva komkhuba wokwehla, i-bullish engulfing ingesinye sezisekelo zokuguquka ezibhekwa kakhulu kunoma yiliphi igrafu, ngoba ikhombisa amandla eshintsha uhlangothi ngekhandlela elilodwa. Yisisekelo, hhayi isivumelwano. 🐂

quiz.q: Umzimba omkhulu oluhlaza ugwinya ngokuphelele umzimba obomvu ongaphambi kwawo. Yiliphi leli phethini lamakhandlela amabili?
options: I-bearish engulfing, abathengisi bathathe izintambo
I-bullish engulfing, abathengi banqobe abathengisi
I-double bottom
Ama-doji amabili alandelanayo

2️⃣ ISIKWELETU ASINCIPHI UMA UPHAMBENE. Yile ngxenye engaposwa muntu, futhi yiso sonke isifundo. Kunalokho amasheya ehla ngo-10%. I-{c}1,000 yakho manje isingu-{c}900. Usamkweleta umngani wakho i-{c}800 ephelele. Hhayi u-{c}720. I-{c}800 ephelele. Ngakho konke ukwehla kuka-{c}100 kuphuma ENGXENYENI YAKHO, futhi i-{c}200 yakho manje isingu-{c}100. Ukushintsha kuka-10% kukubize u-50%.

Funda lezo zimbili futhi. Umngani ofanayo, u-10% ofanayo. Imali yakho ihamba ngesivinini esiphindwe kahlanu kuzo zombili izindlela, ngoba isikweletu asikaze sithathe ingxenye yobuhlungu.

3️⃣ UMNGANI UKHOKHISA IRENTI, NSUKU ZONKE, KUYO YONKE INTO. Hhayi ku-{c}800 yakhe. Kuyo yonke i-{c}1,000 oyilawulayo. Njalo ebusuku uyibambile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi inani likhuphukile, lehlile, noma alishintshanga nhlobo.

Futhi kukhona into yesine efihlekile ngaphakathi kweyesithathu. Uma i-{c}200 yakho isincipha, umngani wakho akakushayeli ucingo ukuze nixoxe. Uyathengisa. Ngokushesha, ngokuzenzakalelayo, nganoma yiliphi inani elitholakalayo, ngoba ku-{c}800 yakhe okusengozini futhi akalindele umbono wakho. Lokho kunegama, futhi uzoluhlangabeza ezifundweni ezintathu ezizayo: ukuqedwa kwesikweletu.

Ngakho: inzuzo enkulu, ukulahlekelwa okukhulu, irenti njalo ebusuku, nomunye umuntu onomunwe enkinobhweni yokuthengisa. I-leverage akuyona imali yamahhala enobungozi obuncane. Yisikweletu esinazo zonke lezo zinto ezine, futhi izikhangiso zikukhombisa eyokuqala kuphela. 🧠

quiz.q: Umngani ufaka u-800 NT, wena ufaka u-200 NT, futhi ndawonye nilawula amasheya angu-1,000 NT. Amasheya ehla ngo-10%. Hudula uye kulokho u-200 NT wakho siqu osekubiza khona manje.
quiz.explanation: Isikweletu asinciphi uma uphambene. Amasheya manje abiza u-900 NT futhi umngani wakho usakweletwa u-800 NT ophelele, ngakho u-100 NT yilokho okusele kuwe. Ukwehla kuka-10% kwamasheya kuthathe uhhafu wemali yakho, ngoba isikweletu asithathi lutho lobuhlungu. Kusebenza ngendlela efanayo uma kukhuphuka, futhi yileyo ngxenye izikhangiso ezikukhombisa yona.

68.title: I-Margin Yidiphozithi, Akukona Ukuthenga
68.content:
Uma uthenga isheya ngo-{c}100, lowo {c}100 usuke ukhishwe emalini yakho bese isheya lihlala ku-akhawunti yakho. Ukushintshaniselana okulula.

I-margin ayisebenzi kanjalo. Uma uvula isikhundla se-leverage ubeka idiphozithi, futhi leyo diphozithi ayikona ukukhokhela okuthile. Iyisibambiso esimelene nokulahlekelwa kwakho. Ihlala lapho, ikhiyiwe, futhi isikhundla siyayidla njengoba inani lishintsha limelene nawe.

Ake sithi izinga lediphozithi lingu-25%. Ubeka phansi u-250 NT bese ulawula u-1,000 NT wesikhundla. Bheka i-akhawunti yakho:

• Inani alishintshi: u-250 wakho usengu-250. Ngaphandle kokuthi izindleko zokuboleka seziqalile, ngakho usencane ngokuthule.
• Inani lehla ngo-5%: isikhundla silahlekelwe ngu-50 NT. Idiphozithi yakho empeleni isingu-200. Imali yakho ekhululekile ayishintshanga. I-akhawunti yakho incane.
• Inani lehla ngo-20%: isikhundla silahlekelwe ngu-200 NT. Idiphozithi yakho isehlele ku-50. Awenzanga lutho. Awuthengisanga lutho. Ubukele nje.

Amagama amathathu asesikrinini ngasinye kuleli gumbi:

🔒 I-USED MARGIN: yonke idiphozithi osuyibekile njengamanje.
💰 I-ACCOUNT EQUITY: imali yakho ekhululekile, kanye ne-margin oyibekile, kuhlanganise noma kususwe inzuzo nokulahlekelwa kwazo zonke izikhundla ezivuliwe, kususwe nezindleko zokuboleka ezikhokhiswe kuze kube manje. Yilokho i-akhawunti yakho ekubiza ngempela uma konke kuvalwa manje.
📊 I-MARGIN LEVEL: i-equity ihlukaniswe nge-used margin. Ngaphezu kuka-100% unomqamelo. Ngaphansi kuka-100% imakethe isiqedile umqamelo yaqala nediphozithi.

Nomthetho owodwa omangaza wonke umuntu: i-margin ilinganiswa ku-akhawunti yakho yonke, hhayi kusikhundla ngasinye. Isikhundla esilahlekelwayo sidla isibambiso esibambe esizuzayo. Yingakho u-"esinye isikhundla sami sisaphila" ungeyona impendulo. 🔒

quiz.q: Izinga lediphozithi lingu-25%, ngakho u-250 NT wemali yakho ulawula isikhundla esingu-1,000 NT. Inani lehla ngo-8% ngenkathi wena ungenzi lutho nhlobo. Hudula uye kulokho lokho kwehla osekukubize khona.
quiz.explanation: Idiphozithi akukona ukukhokhela okuthile, iyisibambiso, futhi ukulahlekelwa kubalwa kuyo yonke i-1,000 NT oyilawulayo. U-8% ka-1,000 NT ngu-80 NT. Awuthengisanga lutho futhi imali yakho ekhululekile ayishintshanga, kodwa u-80 NT wediphozithi yakho engu-250 NT usudliwe futhi i-akhawunti yakho isincane ngo-80 NT. Uma ubala u-8% kudiphozithi esikhundleni salokho uthola u-20 NT, futhi yilelo phutha elenza i-leverage ibukeke ingenabungozi obungako.

69.title: I-Margin Call
69.content:
I-margin call yisikhathi lapho i-margin level yakho yehla ngaphansi kuka-100%. Ngamagama alula: umqamelo wakho wenzuzo usuphelile futhi imakethe isiqale ukudla idiphozithi uqobo.

Nakhu ukuthi kuzwakala kanjani ngempela, ngoba incazelo yasencwadini iyayidlula ingxenye ebalulekile.

Ayikaze ifike ngosuku oluhle. Ifika uma isikhundla sesibi kakade, uma usuzitshele kabili ukuthi sizobuya, futhi uma ungasakwazi ukwenza isinqumo esizolile. Akusiyo isexwayiso esimnene. Yisidingo: faka imali eyengeziwe, noma vala izikhundla, noma umhlinzeki azikuvalele.

Unezinyathelo ezintathu kodwa ezimbili kuphela ezingezakho.

1️⃣ VALA okuthile. Lokhu kukhulula i-margin ngokushesha futhi cishe kuhlala kuyimpendulo efanele. Kubuye kusho ukuvuma ukuthi ubuphambene, okuyisona sizathu sangempela sokuthi abantu bangakwenzi.
2️⃣ FAKA imali. Lokhu akulungisi lutho. Kukuthengela ithuba lokuqhubeka uphambene isikhathi eside, esikhundleni osukhethe kabi, ngemali obungahlelile ukuyibeka engozini. Ukufaka imali ku-margin call yindlela ukuhweba okubi okuguqulwa ngayo kube yinyanga embi.
3️⃣ UNGENZI LUTHO. Bese isinyathelo sesithathu senzeka ngaphandle kwakho, futhi sinegama.

Abalawuli bakuthatha njengokubalulekile kangangokuthi babhala inombolo emthethweni. Izinkampani zaseYurophu, e-UK nase-Australia kufanele zivale ngokuzenzakalelayo izikhundla zeklayenti elijwayelekile uma i-margin yalo yehlela ku-50% yalokho obekudingeka. Hhayi 'kufanele mhlawumbe'. Kumele. Bawubhala lowo mthetho ngoba uma abantu beshiywa banqume bodwa, bakhetha inketho 3 balahlekelwa ngaphezu kwalokho ababenakho. ⚠️

quiz.q: I-margin level yakho isehlele ku-80% futhi usesimweni se-margin call. Yisiphi isinyathelo esinciphisa ngempela ingozi yokuqedwa kwesikweletu esikhundleni sokuvele sikubambezele?
quiz.explanation: Ukuvala kukubuyisela idiphozithi ngokushesha, ngakho i-margin level yeqa phezulu ngaso leso sikhathi. Ukufaka imali kukuthengela nje ithuba lokuqhubeka uphambene isikhathi eside ekuhwebeni osukukhethe kabi. Ukulinda yindlela ukuqedwa kwesikweletu okwenzeka ngayo. Futhi isikhundla sesibili esibheke kolunye uhlangothi sidinga idiphozithi yaso, ngakho sisebenzisa i-margin eningi, hhayi encane.
options: Ukufaka imali eyengeziwe ku-akhawunti
Ukulinda ukuthi i-margin level iphinde ikhuphuke
Ukuvala esinye sezikhundla ozivulile
Ukuvula isikhundla sesibili esibheke kolunye uhlangothi

70.title: Ukuqedwa Kwesikweletu, Nenani Okufanele Ulazi Kuqala
70.desc: Inani ncamashi lapho i-akhawunti yakho ifika ku-zero
70.content:
Ukuqedwa kwesikweletu yilapho umhlinzeki ekuvalela izikhundla zakho ngoba idiphozithi yakho isicishe iphele. Kwenzeka ngokuzenzakalelayo. Kwenzeka ngokushesha. Akekho obuza umbono wakho, akekho obheka ukuthi ubusuzobe uqinisile yini, futhi akukho ukudlulisa icala.

Inombolo eyodwa ewusizo kunazo zonke kuso sonke lesi sahluko YINANI LOKUQEDWA KWESIKWELETU: inani langempela, ngama{cPlural} angempela, lapho lokho kwenzeka khona.

Hhayi iphesenti. Inani. Ngoba u-'ungalahlekelwa yidiphozithi yakho' ungumusho ongawunqekuzela ikhanda bese uyawukhohlwa, kanti u-'i-{tech} iku-{c}87.40 bese i-akhawunti yakho ayinalutho' uyiqiniso ongalihlola egrafini ngaphambi kokuba ucindezele noma yini.

Sonke isikrini kuleli gumbi sikukhombisa ngaphambi kokuba uqinisekise, kudwetshwe esikalini esifanayo negrafu ukuze ubone ukuthi likude kangakanani ngempela. Izinto ezimbili ozozibona ngokushesha, futhi zombili ziyisifundo:

📏 Idiphozithi enkulu ikhweza inani lokuqedwa kwesikweletu libe kude. Imali yakho eningi efakiwe isho ukuthi inani kufanele lehle kakhulu ngaphambi kokuba imali yakho iphele.
⚡ Idiphozithi encane ilidonsela eduze nenani lanamuhla. Ngediphozithi engu-10%, ukuqedwa kwesikweletu kucishe kube ukushintsha kuka-10%, kanti ukushintsha kuka-10% kuyisonto elijwayelekile.

Bese kufika iqiniso elibuhlungu. Inani lokuqedwa kwesikweletu yilapho injini ihlose ukukuvala khona, hhayi lapho uqinisekiswa ukuthi uzophuma khona. Uma izindaba ezimbi zifika ebusuku bese imakethe ivula ngezansi kakhulu kwalelo zinga, uvalwa ngalokho imakethe ezokukhokha ngempela. Yilelo igebe, futhi isifundo 78 simayelana nalo.

Yazi inani lakho lokuqedwa kwesikweletu ngaphambi kokuvula. Uma ungakwazi ukulisho ngomlomo, awukuqondi lokho kuhweba osuzokwenza. 💀

quiz.q: Ubeka u-200 NT njengediphozithi ukuze ulawule u-1,000 NT wempahla ebiza u-100 NT. Hudula inani ulehlisele lapho idiphozithi yakho iphelela khona.
quiz.explanation: Ulawula amayunithi angu-10, ngakho yonke i-1 NT inani elehla ngayo ikubiza u-10 NT. Idiphozithi yakho engu-200 NT iyaphela ku-80 NT, okuwukwehla kuka-20% kuphela.

71.title: Indlela Yokubuya Iyakhuphuka
71.desc: Kungani ukulahlekelwa kunzima ukukubuyisa kunalokho okubukeka ngakho
71.content:
Ukulahlekelwa nenzuzo kuzwakala kuphambene. Akunjalo, futhi izibalo azisondelani nakancane.

Ulahlekelwa ngo-10%? Udinga u-+11% ukuze ubuye. Kuyacasula, kodwa kulungile.
Ulahlekelwa ngo-50%? Udinga u-+100%. Kufanele UPHINDE KABILI ukuze nje ulingane.
Ulahlekelwa ngo-75%? Udinga u-+300%.
Ulahlekelwa ngo-90%? Udinga u-+900%.

Isizathu silula uma usubona: inzuzo ibalwa enqwabeni encane osele nayo. U-100 wehlela ku-50, futhi ukuze ukhuphuke usuka ku-50 ubuyele ku-100 leyo nqwaba encane kufanele iphindwe kabili.

Manje faka i-leverage, bese ubona ukuthi yenzani ngempela. Ayigcini ngokwenza inzuzo yakho isheshe. Ikwehlisela phansi kulelo thebula ngentambama eyodwa. Ukwehla kuka-12% esheyeni, okuyisonto elibi kodwa elijwayelekile, kuwukushaywa kuka-48% ku-akhawunti yakho ngediphozithi engu-25%. Manje usudinga u-+92% ukuze ubuyele lapho uqale khona, ngenxa yesonto elingakaze libe sezindabeni.

Yingakho ochwepheshe bekhuluma ngokuvikela imali abanayo ngaphambi kokukhuluma ngokunye, futhi yingakho u-"ngizoyibuyisa" ungumusho obiza kunayo yonke ekuhwebeni. Ukuyibuyisa kunzima ngezibalo kunokuyilahla, ngaso sonke isikhathi. ⛰️

quiz.q: I-akhawunti yakho yehle ngo-75%. Hudula uye kwinzuzo oyidingayo kusukela lapha ukuze nje ubuyele lapho uqale khona.
quiz.explanation: U-100 NT wehlela ku-25 NT. Ukuze ufinyelele ku-100 futhi, lowo 25 kufanele uphindwe kane, okuyinzuzo engu-300%. Ukukhuphuka kubalwa enqwabeni encane osele nayo, yingakho kunzima kakhulu kunokwehla.

72.title: Irenti Yemali Ebolekiwe
72.content:
Ubolekile ukuze ube naleso sikhundla. Ngakho uyakukhokhela. Njalo ebusuku.

Izindleko zokuboleka (kwezinye izindawo zibizwa nge-swap, noma imali yobusuku) zikhokhiswa nsuku zonke, futhi nakhu okubamba wonke umuntu: zikhokhiswa kuso SONKE isikhundla, hhayi kuleyo ngxenye oyibolekile. Beka phansi u-500 NT ukuze ulawule u-2,000 NT bese ukhokha irenti ku-2,000.

Kubalwa kanjani: izinga lenzalo eliyisisekelo, kuhlangene nenzuzo yomhlinzeki, kuhlukaniswe ngo-365, kuphindwe ngesikhundla sakho sonke. Uzibona zombili izingxenye esikrinini kule app, ngoba izindleko ongakwazi ukuzihlukanisa yizindleko ongakwazi ukuzahlulela. Ngo-7.3% cishe ngonyaka, lokho kufinyelela cishe ku-0.02% wesikhundla sakho ngobusuku ngabunye.

Kuzwakala kungelutho. Manje bheka kudla ukuhweba okuzuzayo. 🧾

UKUHWEBA OKUQINISILE KODWA USALAHLEKELWA

Uvula isikhundla se-2,000 NT ku-{retail} ngediphozithi engu-500 NT. Ulindele ukukhuphuka, futhi kuvela ukuthi uqinisile: ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezilandelayo i-{retail} ikhuphuka ngo-2%.

• Inzuzo yakho: u-2% ka-2,000 = 40 NT. Kudiphozithi engu-500 NT lokho ngu-+8%. Kuhle.
• Irenti yakho: u-0.02% ka-2,000 = 0.40 NT, njalo ebusuku.

Ubusuku 50: usukhokhe u-20 NT. Usenzuzweni engu-20 NT sekukonke. Usawina.
Ubusuku 100: usukhokhe u-40 NT. Inzuzo yakho engu-40 NT manje ayisabizi lutho. Ubuqinisile kodwa awenzanga lutho.
Ubusuku 180: usukhokhe u-72 NT. Inzuzo yakho isengu-40 NT. USEHLE ngo-32 NT, okungu-6.4% ongaphansi kwediphozithi yakho, ekuhwebeni lapho ufunde khona imakethe kahle izinyanga eziyisithupha.

Funda lokho futhi. Inani lenze kanye lokho okushilo. Kodwa ulahlekelwe.

Nguwo lowo musho ozowuthatha kulesi sifundo: esikhundleni se-leverage, ukuqinisa kunosuku lokuphelelwa isikhathi. Kulesi sibonelo kusebusuku obungu-100 ukusuka manje, futhi ungakubalela ngaphambi kokuvula. Hlukanisa inzuzo oyethembayo ngerenti yobusuku. Yibona lobo busuku umbono wakho obubizayo.

Okuphambene kufanele kuqashelwe futhi. Enye ingxenye yale app ifundisa ukuhlanganisa, lapho isikhathi sikwenzela imali ngokuthule ulele. Lo ngumshini ofanayo, usebenza ubuyela emuva, ukhomba kuwe. ⏳

quiz.q: Ubambe isikhundla se-leverage se-2,000 NT esibiza u-0.40 NT ngobusuku ezindlekweni zokuboleka. Inani likhuphuka ngokwanele ukukunika inzuzo engu-40 NT, bese liyama. Ngemva kobusuku obungakhi leyo nzuzo isuke isidliwe yonke?
options: Ayidliwa nanini, ngoba izindleko zokuboleka zikhokhiswa engxenyeni ebolekiwe kuphela
Cishe ubusuku obungu-100, ngoba inzuzo engu-40 NT ihlukaniswe ngo-0.40 NT ngobusuku ingu-100
Cishe ubusuku obungu-20, ngoba izindleko zokuboleka zikhokhiswa kudiphozithi yakho engu-500 NT
Izindleko zokuboleka zikhokhiswa kuphela uma isikhundla sivalwa ngokulahlekelwa

73.title: Ama-Future: Iwashi Nokugoqa
73.desc: Izindleko ezifanayo, kodwa zilethwa ngenye indlela
73.content:
Ama-future nama-CFD angabazala. Womabili asebenzisa i-leverage, womabili asebenzisa i-margin, womabili angakuqeda. Izinto ezimbili zenza ama-future ahluke, futhi eyesibili yiyona ethokozisayo.

⏰ 1. ANOSUKU LOKUPHELA. Isivumelwano ngasinye se-future siyaphela. Uwoyela kaMashi, ummbila kaJuni, inkomba kaSepthemba. Uma usuku lufika, isivumelwano siyakhokhwa bese siyayeka ukuba khona. U-'bambelela ulinde ukuthi kubuye' awukho nhlobo ohlwini, ngoba isivumelwano ngeke sisaba khona. I-CFD ayipheli nanini, okuzwakala kungcono kuze ukhumbule ukuthi ikhokhisa irenti unomphela.

🔄 2. IZINDLEKO ZAKHELWE ENANINI, AZIKHOKHISWA NJALO EBUSUKU. Yile ngxenye eshiywa ngabantu. I-future ivamise ukungakukhokhisi imali yobusuku yezindleko zokuboleka. Kunalokho, izindleko zokubamba into kuze kufike lolo suku sezivele zibhakwe enanini lesivumelwano. Izivumelwano zezinsuku ezizayo zivame ukubiza ngaphezu kwezivumelwano zezinsuku eziseduze, futhi lelo gebe yizona zindleko ezifanayo zokubamba, zihlezi ngaphakathi enanini.

Ngakho kwenzekani uma umhwebi efuna ukubamba isikhundla ngemva kokuphela? UYAGOQA: uvala isivumelwano esiphelayo, avule esilandelayo. Futhi uma esilandelayo sibiza kakhulu, ukhokha lowo mehluko. Kukho konke ukugoqa. Yileyo renti yobusuku ye-CFD, iqoqwa ngezinkokhelo ezinkulu ezingavamile.

Isifinyezo esiqotho:

• I-CFD: alukho usuku lokugcina, irenti njalo ebusuku, ibhaliwe esitatimendeni sakho.
• I-future: usuku lokugcina oluqinile, izindleko zifihlwe ngaphakathi enanini futhi zikhokhwa kukho konke ukugoqa, kulula ukungazinaki.

Akukho okumahhala kukho. Okukodwa nje kwethula ibhili ngenhlonipho ethe xaxa, futhi izindleko ongazibonayo yizona ezizokumangaza kakhulu. ⏳

quiz.q: Umhwebi ufuna ukubamba isikhundla se-future ngemva kosuku lwaso lokuphela, futhi isivumelwano esilandelayo sihwebelana ngenani eliphezulu kunesiphelayo. Kwenzekani uma egoqa?
quiz.explanation: Ukugoqa kusho ukuvala isivumelwano esizophela bese uvula esilandelayo. Uma esilandelayo sibiza kakhulu, ukhokha lowo mehluko, futhi ukwenza futhi kukho konke ukugoqa. Yizona zindleko ezifanayo zokubamba i-CFD ezikhokhisa zona njalo ebusuku, ziqoqwa ngezigaxa ezinkulu futhi zifihlwe ngaphakathi enanini esikhundleni sokubhalwa esitatimendeni sakho.
options: Ukhokha igebe phakathi kwesivumelwano esiphelayo nesilandelayo
Ukhokhelwa igebe phakathi kwamanani ezivumelwano zombili
Ayikho imali eshintsha izandla, ngoba ukugoqa kungukuhweba okukodwa
Isikhundla siba yi-CFD futhi siqhubeke singenalo usuku lokuphela

74.title: Ukuya Kwi-Short: Ukulahlekelwa Okungenaphansi
74.desc: Kungani ukubheja ukwehla kungenalo uphahla lwemvelo
74.content:
Konke kule app kuze kube manje bekuyi-long: uyathenga, ufuna inani likhuphuke. Ama-derivative akuvumela ukuthi uye kwi-short, okusho ukubheja ukuthi inani lizokwehla. Uvula i-short, inani lehle, uthole inzuzo.

I-short iwusizo ngempela futhi ayimbi. Yindlela umlimi abamba ngayo inani ngaphambi kokuvuna nendlela ifandi elivikela ngayo i-portfolio. Ukuyiqonda kukwenza ube ngcono ekufundeni izimakethe, ngoba okokuqala ubona zombili izinhlangothi zakho konke ukuhweba.

Kodwa kukhona isibalo esisodwa ku-short esingenaso esifana naso kwenye indawo, futhi kufanele usifake ekhanda.

📉 UMA UTHENGA, isimo sakho esibi kunazo zonke ukuthi inani liye ku-zero. Ulahlekelwa ngu-100% walokho okufakile. Kubi, kodwa kunaphansi. Kukhona lapho kuphelela khona.
📈 UMA UYA KWI-SHORT, inani elimelene nawe lisho inani eliKHUPHUKAYO. Futhi awukho umthetho ndawo othi inani livunyelwe ukukhuphukela kuphi. Isheya eliphindwa kathathu likubiza u-200% wesikhundla. Isheya elikhuphuka ngokuphindwe kayishumi likubiza u-900%.

Ukulahlekelwa kwe-long kunaphansi. Okwe-short akunakho. Lokho kungalingani yisona sonke isexwayiso.

Izimakethe zangempela ziyakwenza lokhu. Ngezinye izikhathi isheya elinama-short amaningi liyaqhuma, ngoba wonke umuntu ose-short uphoqwa ukuthenga ukuze avale, okuphakamisa inani, okuphoqa nabanye ukuthi bathenge. Kubizwa ngokuthi yi-short squeeze futhi sekwaqeda amafandi.

Izinto ezimbili ezikugcina uphila. Okokuqala, i-short yiyona kanye indawo lapho i-stop-loss iyeka khona ukuba yinketho. Ungalahlekelwa yikho konke okufakile. Kodwa awukwazi ukugcina usukweleta. Lokho kuvikelwa kukhona ngoba, ngaphambi kwakho, abantu babegcina bekweleta. 🕳️

75.title: Ukuguquguquka Kuphindwe Nge-Leverage
75.desc: Kungani i-crypto idinga idiphozithi enkulu kunazo zonke lapha
75.content:
Isiphindi esifanayo empahleni ezimbili ezehlukene akusona ukubheja okufanayo. Yilowo wonke umqondo kulesi sifundo, futhi yingakho idiphozithi okumele uyibeke ishintsha ngokuya ngalokho okuhwebayo.

Cabanga ukuthi usuku olujwayelekile lubukeka kanjani:
• Inkomba enkulu ishintsha ngaphansi kuka-1% ezinsukwini eziningi.
• Isheya elilodwa lingashintsha ngo-2% noma ngo-3%.
• I-crypto ishintsha njalo ngo-5% noma ngo-10%, futhi usuku luka-20% akulona uhlekelele, luwuLwesibili nje. 🎢

Manje beka idiphozithi encane ngemuva kwakho konke lokho. Ngediphozithi engu-10%, ukushintsha kuka-10% kuyakuqeda. Kunkomba, lokho kwenzeka kanye eminyakeni eminingi. Ku-crypto kwenzeka cishe njalo ngenyanga. Idiphozithi efanayo. Amathuba okusinda ahluke ngokuphelele.

Abalawuli bakubalile lokhu bakubhala emithethweni. Ngesikhathi i-ESMA ivimbela i-leverage yama-CFD kulo lonke iYurophu ngoMashi 2018, ayizange ikhethe inombolo eyodwa. Yayihlukanisa ngamazinga: u-30:1 emabhanqweni amakhulu emali, u-20:1 egolideni nasezinkombeni ezinkulu, u-10:1 kwezinye izimpahla, u-5:1 emasheyeni ngawodwana, kwathi phansi ngqo, u-2:1 kwi-crypto. U-2:1 usho idiphozithi engu-50%. Ku-crypto badinga UHHAFU wesikhundla ngemali yangempela, izinga eliqine kunawo wonke ohlwini.

Le app yenza into efanayo, ngesizathu esifanayo, futhi ikusho esikrinini esikhundleni sokukufihla:

💱 I-forex: idiphozithi encane kunazo zonke, ngoba amabhanqa amakhulu ashintsha kancane.
🥇 Igolide nezimpahla: enkulu.
📊 Amasheya, izinkomba nama-ETF: enkulu nakakhulu.
🪙 I-crypto: idiphozithi enkulu kunazo zonke, ngoba i-crypto ishintsha ngamandla kunakho konke.

I-crypto ayivinjelwe lapha, futhi lokho kwenziwe ngamabomu. Ungayihweba. Awukwazi nje ukuyihweba ngediphozithi encane, ngoba ngediphozithi encane usuku olujwayelekile lwe-crypto belungaqeda i-akhawunti yakho ungakaqedi ukufunda ngayo. Idiphozithi enkulu akusiyo i-app enenkani nge-crypto. Yi-app eqinisekisa ukuthi usuku olujwayelekile alukwazi ukukubulala.

Kubalulekile ukwazi: umlawuli wase-UK waya ngale kwezinga nje. Ngo-2021 wavimbela ngokuphelele ama-derivative e-crypto kumakhasimende ajwayelekile, elinganisela ukuthi abathengi bebezosindisa cishe u-£53 wezigidi. Ungahlangabezana ne-leverage ye-crypto lapha, ngemali yokuzijwayeza nangediphozithi enkulu, noma ungahlangabezana nayo useneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ngemali yangempela ungenaso nesexwayiso. Le yiyona ndlela engcono. 🌡️

76.title: Izinombolo Ezingakhangiswa Muntu
76.content:
Awusoze uzibona lezi zinombolo esikhangisweni. Zivela kubalawuli bezimali, abangacela idatha yangempela yama-akhawunti ezinkampanini, bese beshicilela lokho abakutholile.

🇪🇺 I-ESMA, umlawuli waseYurophu, ngoMashi 2018. Kuwo wonke amazwe e-EU, phakathi kuka-74% no-89% wama-akhawunti ajwayelekile e-CFD alahlekelwa yimali. Ukulahlekelwa okuphakathi nendawo ngekhasimende ngalinye kwakusukela ku-€1,600 kuya ku-€29,000. I-ESMA yawuvimbela lo mkhiqizo ngenxa yalokho.

🇬🇧 I-FCA e-UK, ngoDisemba 2016. Ukuhlaziya kwayo isampula elimele ama-akhawunti amakhasimende kwathola ukuthi u-82% wamakhasimende walahlekelwa yimali kule mikhiqizo.

🇦🇺 I-ASIC e-Australia, eyashicilelwa ngoJanuwari 2026, eyakamuva kunazo zontathu. Onyakeni wezimali ka-2024, u-68% wabatshalizimali abajwayelekile bama-CFD balahlekelwa yimali, sekukonke ngaphezu kuka-A$458 wezigidi. Kulokho, u-A$73 wezigidi kwakuyizindleko.

Ake uhlale nomugqa wokugcina isikhashana. Izigidi ezingu-73 kukho kwakungebona ngisho ukuhweba okubi. Kwakuyizindleko zokudlala: igebe uma ungena, nezindleko zokuboleka ozihlangabezane nazo esifundweni 72.

Abalawuli abathathu abehlukene, amazwe amathathu ehlukene, idatha edlula emashumini amathathu eminyaka ehlukene, futhi impendulo ilokhu iwela phakathi kwezingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu nezingxenye eziyisishiyagalolunye kweziyishumi.

Manje ingxenye ebaluleke kunazo zonke, ngoba yiyona eyenza lokhu kungabi yisibalo sokwesabisa nje. Labo bantu babengeziwula. Babengewona amavila. Iningi labo bekungabantu abadala abanemisebenzi, futhi abaningi babo bafunda igrafu kangcono kunawe njengamanje. Balahlekelwa ngenxa yendlela umkhiqizo owakhiwe ngayo: uqala ungemuva ngenxa yegebe, ukhokha irenti usalinde, futhi i-leverage isho ukuthi ukushintsha okujwayelekile kungakuqeda ngaphambi kokuba umbono wakho ube nesikhathi sokuba yiqiniso.

Lokho yisakhiwo, akulona iphutha lesimilo. Futhi izakhiwo zingehlulwa kuphela ngabantu abaziyo ukuthi zikhona. 📊

77.title: Okwashintsha Lapho Imithetho Ishintsha
77.content:
Isifundo 76 sikunikeze ukulahlekelwa. Lesi sifundo sikunika ucwaningo, futhi kuyinto ebaluleke kunazo zonke kulesi sahluko.

Uma abantu abaningi belahlekelwa ngoba abantu abaningi benganaki, khona-ke ukushintsha imithetho bekungeke kushintshe lutho. Abanganaki bahlala benganaki. Akunjalo?

I-Australia yenza lolo hlolo. NgoMashi 2021 i-ASIC yaphoqa isethi yezivikelo kuyo yonke inkampani ye-CFD esebenzela amakhasimende ajwayelekile: imikhawulo ye-leverage, umthetho ojwayelekile wokuvala ngokuzenzakalelayo, ukuvikelwa kwebhalansi engaphansi kuka-zero, kanye nokuvinjelwa kwezikhuthazi ezifana namabhonasi okubhalisa. Amakhasimende afanayo. Izinkampani ezifanayo. Izimakethe ezifanayo. Kwashintsha imithetho kuphela.

Nakhu okwalinganiswa yi-ASIC ezinyangeni eziyisithupha zokuqala. 🔬

📉 Ukulahlekelwa sekukonke kwama-akhawunti ajwayelekile kwehla ngo-91%, kusuka esilinganisweni sika-A$372 wezigidi ngekota kuya ku-A$33 wezigidi.
📉 Ama-akhawunti ajwayelekile alahlekelwayo ancishiswa ngo-51% ngekota.
📉 Ukuvalwa kwe-margin kwehla ngo-87%.
📉 Izigameko zebhalansi engaphansi kuka-zero zehla ngo-88%.

Akekho owahlakanipha kakhulu ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Kwashintsha umklamo, kwathi izingxenye eziyisishiyagalolunye kweziyishumi zomonakalo zanyamalala nawo.

Kulandela izinto ezimbili, futhi kufanele uzithathe zombili.

Okokuqala: uma ulahlekelwa ekuhwebeni kwe-leverage, okuningi kwalokho okwenzeka kuwe kwakwakhelwe emkhiqizweni ngaphambi kokuba ufike. Lokho akusiyo imvume yokunganaki. Kuyisizathu sokuyihlonipha le nto.

Okwesibili, futhi yile ngxenye ewusizo: izivikelo ezenza umsebenzi yiyona kanye mikhuba lesi sahluko besikufundisa yona. Isikhundla esincane. Indlela yokuphuma ezenzakalelayo. Umkhawulo oqinile womonakalo. Umlawuli kwadingeka awuphoqe umkhakha wonke ukuze athole lowo 91%. Wena ungavele uwukhethe. 🛡️

78.title: Igebe Elidlula Phezu Kwe-Stop Yakho
78.desc: I-stop ngumyalo wokuphuma, akusona isithembiso senani
78.content:
Usuhlangabezane nama-stop-loss esifundweni 19. Nakhu i-leverage ekwenza kuwo.

I-stop-loss ngumyalo: "uma inani lifika kuleli zinga, ngikhiphe." Akusona isivumelwano ngenani ozolithola. Ithi phuma. Ayisho ukuthi phuma kanye lapha.

Isikhathi esiningi lowo mehluko awubalulekile, ngoba amanani ashintsha ngezinyathelo ezincane futhi i-oda lakho ligcwaliswa eduze nezinga lakho. Bese ngezinye izikhathi kuba nomthelela omkhulu kakhulu.

📰 Izimakethe ziyavala. Izindaba zifika ngo-11 ebusuku. Imakethe ivula ngo-8% ngaphansi kwalapho ivale khona, futhi ayikaze ihwebe nakwelinye lamanani aphakathi. I-stop yakho ibisegebeni. Iqhuma uma kuvulwa bese igcwaliswa lapho imakethe ikhona ngempela, okukude kakhulu ngale kwezinga olikhethile.

Ngaphandle kwe-leverage, lolo lusuku olubi. Nge-leverage, kungaba yi-akhawunti yonke, ngoba uma idiphozithi yakho ibincane kunegebe, igebe lidlula ngqo nakwinani lakho lokuqedwa kwesikweletu, bese uvalwa ngaphansi kwezinga injini ebihlose lona.

Zintathu izinto ongazenza ngalokhu, futhi akukho nokukodwa okuyinkimbinkimbi:

1️⃣ Ungathathi i-stop njengesiqiniseko. Yithathe njengomkhuba omuhle kakhulu onobuthakathaka obubodwa obaziwayo.
2️⃣ Yazi ukuthi imakethe yakho ivala nini nokuthi kuhlelwe ini. Imiphumela yezinkampani, izinqumo zamazinga enzalo nokhetho kungamagebe anosuku olubhaliwe.
3️⃣ Yenza isikhundla sibe sincane ukuze igebe lingakwazi ukukuqeda. Lokho ukuzivikela kwangempela, futhi kuyisifundo esilandelayo. I-stop ikuvikela kokujwayelekile. Ubukhulu besikhundla bukuvikela kokungajwayelekile, futhi yikho okungajwayelekile okuqeda abantu ngempela.

Futhi kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi kule app, njengakuyo noma iyiphi i-akhawunti ejwayelekile elawulwa kahle, ukuvikelwa kwebhalansi engaphansi kuka-zero kusho ukuthi igebe alikwazi ukukwehlisela ngaphansi kuka-zero. Ungayilahlekelwa i-akhawunti. Kodwa awukwazi ukugcina usukweleta. 📰

79.title: Ubukhulu Kuqala, Bese Kuza Ukuhweba
79.content:
Nayi into ehlukanisa abantu abahlala isikhathi eside kwabangahlali, futhi cishe iyadina.

Abaqalayo bakhetha ukuhweba, bese bebala ukuthi bafake malini. Ochwepheshe bakwenza ngokuphambene. Baqala banqume ukuthi bazimisele ukulahlekelwa yini, bese kunquma lokho ukuthi isikhundla singaba sikhulu kangakanani.

Umthetho abaningi babo abawusebenzisayo: beka engozini u-1% kuya ku-2% we-akhawunti kunoma yikuphi ukuhweba okukodwa. Hhayi ukufaka u-1%. BEKA ENGOZINI u-1%, okusho ukuthi yilokho olahlekelwa yikho ngempela uma i-stop yakho ishaywa.

Kusebenza kanjani, ngezinyathelo ezintathu:

1️⃣ Khetha ukulahlekelwa kwakho okuphezulu. I-akhawunti engu-10,000 NT, ubeka engozini u-1%, ngakho u-100 NT.
2️⃣ Khetha ukuthi uphambene kuphi. Uzophuma uma inani lehla ngo-5% kusuka lapho ungenele khona.
3️⃣ Hlukanisa. U-100 NT wokulahlekelwa okwamukelekile, ebangeni le-stop elingu-5%, kusho isikhundla se-2,000 NT. Lobo bukhulu bakho. Akuwona umuzwa. Yisibalo.

Shintsha i-stop bese nobukhulu bushintsha ngokuzenzakalelayo. I-stop eqinile engu-2% ikuvumela u-5,000 NT. I-stop ebanzi engu-10% ikwehlisela ku-1,000 NT. Uma ukuhweba kunobungozi obukhulu, kufanele kube kuncane, futhi isibalo sikwenzela lokho ukuze umoya wakho ungadingi ukukwenza.

Kungani u-1%? Ngoba kwenza ukulahlekelwa okulandelanayo kubekezeleleke. Ukulahlekelwa okuyishumi okulandelanayo ku-1% kukushiya nengxenye engu-90% ye-akhawunti yakho nomoya omubi. Ukulahlekelwa okuyishumi okulandelanayo ku-20% kukushiya cishe no-11% we-akhawunti yakho ungenayo indlela yokubuya, futhi usuvele wazi esifundweni 71 ukuthi lokho kukhuphuka kunzima kangakanani.

Akekho osinda ezimakethe ngokukhetha abawinayo. Bonke abasindayo bakwenza ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho kulahlekelwa okukodwa okungabaqeda. 📐

quiz.q: I-akhawunti engu-10,000 NT. Uzobeka engozini u-1% kulokhu kuhweba, futhi uzophuma uma inani lehla ngo-5% kusuka lapho ungenele khona. Hudula uye kubukhulu besikhundla obuhlonipha lokho.
quiz.explanation: U-1% ka-10,000 NT ngu-100 NT, futhi yilokho okuphezulu ovumile ukukulahlekelwa. I-stop engu-5% isho u-100 NT ohlukaniswe ngo-5%, okuyisikhundla esingu-2,000 NT. Uma uhudulela phezulu, isibonisi sikukhombisa ubeka engozini okungaphezu kwalokho obukunqumile.

80.title: Kungani Ukuwina Kuzwakala Njengekhono
80.content:
I-leverage ayiyona ikakhulu inkinga yezibalo. Izibalo zilula. Yinkinga yengqondo, futhi nazi ezintathu ezibamba wonke umuntu.

🎯 1. UKUKHOHLISWA NGUMPHUMELA: ukuwina kuzwakala njengekhono. Uthatha isikhundla esikhulu ngokweqile, sisebenze, wenze imali eningi ngentambama eyodwa, bese ubuchopho bakho bubhala "ngiyakwazi lokhu." Abuzange bubhale okwenzeke ngempela, okuwukuthi uthathe ubungozi obubi wathola umphumela omuhle. Lezo yizinto ezahlukene, futhi imakethe izokukhokhela ngenjabulo isinqumo esibi izikhathi eziningana ngaphambi kokuqoqa. Into eyingozi kunazo zonke engenzeka kumhwebi omusha ukuwina kalula ekuqaleni.

😤 2. UKUHWEBA NGENZONDO: ufuna ukubuyisa, manje. Uyalahlekelwa, kuyababa, futhi isifiso siba khona ngokushesha. Ngakho wenza isikhundla sibe sikhulu. Manje usubeka isikhundla sakho esikhulu kunazo zonke ngesikhathi kanye lapho ukwahlulela kwakho kubi kunakuqala, ekuhwebeni okukhethe ngoba ubuthukuthele hhayi ngoba bekukuhle. Imakethe ayazi ukuthi ulahlekelwe futhi ayikukweleti lutho. Uma uzwa lokhu, ubukhulu obufanele bungu-zero. Vala i-app.

🕳️ 3. UKUJAHA OKULAHLEKILE: "ngizovele ngibambelele kuze kubuye." Lokhu kugqokiswe njengokubekezela, yingakho kunzima kangaka ukukubona. Ukubekezela wuhlelo olwenze uzolile ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ukujaha wuhlelo olusungule ngemva kokuba inani liphambane nawe, futhi uphawu lulula: indlela yakho yokuphuma ishintshile. Uma uzithola uchaza ukuthi kungani izinga obulibekile lingaselona izinga elifanele, lokho akukona ukuhlaziya okusha. Kungu-ego wakho oxoxisanayo.

Ukuzivikela kuzo zontathu kuyafana futhi akukhazimuli. Nquma konke usazolile, ukubhale phansi, bese uthatha lowo mfanekiso wakho ovela phakathi nokuhweba njengomxoxi ongathembekile. 🧠

Akulona ithuluzi ekhithini yakho; yilokho umhlinzeki akwenzayo ukuze avikele isikweletu sakhe uma idiphozithi yakho isicishe iphele, nganoma yiliphi inani imakethe elikhokhayo, ngenkathi usesikoleni noma ulele.

I-stop-loss nguwe onquma isimo sakho esibi kunazo zonke kusengaphambili. Ukuqedwa kwesikweletu yilokho okwenzekayo uma ungakwenzanga lokho.

Womabili ama-oda akho athembekile ngendlela efanayo, futhi usuvele ukwazi esifundweni 78: aqhuma ezingeni lakho bese egcwaliswa ngalokho imakethe ekukhokhayo ngempela. Igebe elidlula phezu kwe-stop yakho likugcwalisa ngale kokugxuma, okubi kakhulu. Igebe elidlula ku-take-profit yakho nalo likugcwalisa ngale, okungcono. Iqiniso elifanayo, libheke nhlangothi zombili.

Umthetho owodwa wokubeka, futhi le app iyawuphoqelela ngesizathu esikrinini: i-stop yakho kufanele ibe phakathi kwenani lamanje nenani lakho lokuqedwa kwesikweletu. I-stop engale kwenani lokuqedwa ibingeke iqhume nanini, ngoba umhlinzeki ubezobe esekuvalile kuqala, ngakho i-app iyayenqaba futhi ikutshele ukuthi kungani.

Iminyango emithathu yokuphuma kukho konke ukuhweba. Emibili yayo inegama lakho esibambweni. Ukuphuma ngomunye wayo, ngosuku olukhethile, ezingeni olikhethe usazolile, yikho lonke lesi sahluko ebesikufundisa ukukwenza. 🚪
